sentences.english: Jiayue, Li Wen, look at the menu, what do you want to eat?
sentences.spanish: Jiayue, Li Wen, mirad el menú, ¿qué queréis comer?

sentences.hanzi: 飞了这么远，现在还真是又饿又渴。

sentences.spanish: Después de volar hasta ahora, ahora tengo mucha hambre y sed.

sentences.hanzi: 那多点，别客气。你们喝什么饮料？
sentences.pinyin: Nà duō diǎn, bié kèqì. Nǐmen hē shénme yǐnliào?
sentences.english: That's more, you're welcome. What do you drink?
sentences.spanish: Eso es más, de nada. ¿Qué bebes?

sentences.hanzi: 你们喝什么饮料？

sentences.english: What do you drink?
sentences.spanish: ¿Qué bebes?

sentences.hanzi: 好久没喝中国茶，也好久没吃饺子了。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎojiǔ méi hē zhōngguó chá, yě hǎojiǔ méi chī jiǎozǐle.
sentences.english: It’s been a while since I drank Chinese tea and I haven’t eaten dumplings for a while.
sentences.spanish: Ha pasado un tiempo desde que bebí té chino y hace tiempo que no como bolas de masa.

sentences.hanzi: 这家饭馆的服务很热情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de fúwù hěn rèqíng.
sentences.english: The service in this restaurant is very friendly.
sentences.spanish: El servicio en este restaurante es muy amable.

sentences.hanzi: 服务员，再给我们拿一双筷子、一个勺子和一个碗。

sentences.english: Waiter, bring us another pair of chopsticks, a spoon and a bowl.
sentences.spanish: Camarero, tráiganos otro par de palillos, una cuchara y un cuenco.

sentences.hanzi: 再给我们拿一双筷子。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒmen ná yīshuāng kuàizǐ.
sentences.english: Get us another pair of chopsticks.
sentences.spanish: Consíguenos otro par de palillos.

sentences.hanzi: 再给我们拿一双筷子、一个勺子和一个碗。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒmen ná yīshuāng kuàizǐ, yīgè sháozǐ hé yīgè wǎn.
sentences.english: Get us another pair of chopsticks, a spoon and a bowl.
sentences.spanish: Consíguenos otro par de palillos, una cuchara y un cuenco.

sentences.hanzi: 再给我们拿一双筷子、一个勺子和一个碗。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒmen ná yīshuāng kuàizǐ, yīgè sháozǐ hé yīgè wǎn.
sentences.english: Get us another pair of chopsticks, a spoon and a bowl.
sentences.spanish: Consíguenos otro par de palillos, una cuchara y un cuenco.

sentences.hanzi: 再给我们拿一双筷子、一个勺子和一个碗。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒmen ná yīshuāng kuàizǐ, yīgè sháozǐ hé yīgè wǎn.
sentences.english: Get us another pair of chopsticks, a spoon and a bowl.
sentences.spanish: Consíguenos otro par de palillos, una cuchara y un cuenco.

sentences.hanzi: 好的，请等一下，我马上去拿。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎo de, qǐng děng yīxià, wǒ mǎshàng qù ná.
sentences.english: Okay, please wait a moment, I'll get it right away.
sentences.spanish: Bien, espera un momento, lo conseguiré de inmediato.

sentences.hanzi: 这家饭馆的服务很热情，菜也都做很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de fúwù hěn rèqíng, cài yě dū zuò hěn hào chī.
sentences.english: The service in this restaurant is very friendly and the dishes are delicious.
sentences.spanish: El servicio en este restaurante es muy amable y los platos deliciosos.

sentences.hanzi: 你们尝尝喜不喜欢这些菜？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐmen cháng cháng xǐ bù xǐhuān zhèxiē cài?
sentences.english: Do you like these dishes?
sentences.spanish: ¿Te gustan estos platos?

sentences.hanzi: 服务员都记住我们爱吃的菜了。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán dōu jì zhù wǒmen ài chī de càile.
sentences.english: The waiters all remembered our favorite dishes.
sentences.spanish: Todos los camareros recordaron nuestros platos favoritos.

sentences.hanzi: 今天送您一些水果，请用。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān sòng nín yīxiē shuǐguǒ, qǐng yòng.
sentences.english: I’ll give you some fruit today, please use it.
sentences.spanish: Te daré algo de fruta hoy, por favor úsala.

sentences.hanzi: 这个鸡肉饭太好吃了，我要再来吃一次。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jīròu fàn tài hào chīle, wǒ yào zàilái chī yīcì.
sentences.english: This chicken rice is so delicious, I will eat it again.
sentences.spanish: Este arroz con pollo está tan delicioso que lo volveré a comer.

sentences.hanzi: 你可以拿走这张菜单，看看下次还吃点什么。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ ná zǒu zhè zhāng càidān, kàn kàn xià cì hái chī diǎn shénme.
sentences.english: You can take this menu and see what you want next time.
sentences.spanish: Puedes tomar este menú y ver lo que quieres la próxima vez.

sentences.hanzi: 不用拿菜单，在手机上就能看到。
sentences.pinyin: Bùyòng ná càidān, zài shǒujī shàng jiù néng kàn dào.
sentences.english: No need to pick up the menu, you can see it on your phone.
sentences.spanish: No es necesario levantar el menú, puedes verlo en tu teléfono.

sentences.hanzi: 也可以选好了，让他们给你送。
sentences.pinyin: Yě kěyǐ xuǎn hǎole, ràng tāmen gěi nǐ sòng.
sentences.english: You can also choose and have them deliver it to you.
sentences.spanish: También puedes elegir y que te lo entreguen.

sentences.hanzi: 他们家还能送外卖？/ 现在很多饭馆都能送外卖。
sentences.pinyin: tā men jiā hái néng sòng wài mài / xiàn zài hěn duō fàn guǎn dōu néng sòng wài mài
sentences.english: Can they also deliver takeout? / Many restaurants now offer takeout delivery.
sentences.spanish: ¿También pueden entregar comida para llevar? / Muchos restaurantes ahora ofrecen comida para llevar.

sentences.hanzi: 想吃什么就点什么，那真是太方便了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme, nà zhēnshi tài fāngbiànliǎo.
sentences.english: It's so convenient to order whatever you want.
sentences.spanish: Es muy conveniente pedir lo que quieras.

sentences.hanzi: 早饭我吃一个面包，有时候吃一块蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎofàn wǒ chī yīgè miànbāo, yǒu shíhòu chī yīkuài dàngāo.
sentences.english: I eat a piece of bread for breakfast and sometimes a piece of cake.
sentences.spanish: Como un trozo de pan en el desayuno y, a veces, un trozo de tarta.

sentences.hanzi: 我可能好几天只吃方便面。/ 有时候妈妈只做几个简单的菜。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kě néng hǎo jǐ tiān zhǐ chī fāng biàn miàn / yǒu shí hou mā ma zhǐ zuò jǐ ge jiǎn dān de cài
sentences.english: I might go days eating nothing but instant noodles. / Sometimes my mother only cooks a few simple dishes.
sentences.spanish: Podría pasar días comiendo nada más que fideos instantáneos. / A veces mi madre sólo cocina algunos platos sencillos.

sentences.hanzi: 家里又什么吃的都没有，我可能好几天只吃方便面。
sentences.pinyin: Jiālǐ yòu shénme chī de dōu méiyǒu, wǒ kěnéng hǎo jǐ tiān zhǐ chī fāngbiànmiàn.
sentences.english: There was nothing to eat at home, so I might only eat instant noodles for several days.
sentences.spanish: No había nada para comer en casa, así que quizá solo comiera fideos instantáneos durante varios días.

sentences.hanzi: 有时候妈妈只做几个简单的菜，我也非常爱吃。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shíhòu māmā zhǐ zuò jǐ gè jiǎndān de cài, wǒ yě fēicháng ài chī.
sentences.english: Sometimes my mother only cooks a few simple dishes, which I also love to eat.
sentences.spanish: A veces mi madre sólo cocina algunos platos sencillos, que a mí también me encanta comer.

sentences.hanzi: 服务员，再给我们拿一双筷子、一个勺子和一个碗。
sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, zài gěi wǒmen ná yīshuāng kuàizǐ, yīgè sháozǐ hé yīgè wǎn.
sentences.english: Waiter, bring us another pair of chopsticks, a spoon and a bowl.
sentences.spanish: Camarero, tráiganos otro par de palillos, una cuchara y un cuenco.

sentences.hanzi: 小雪的初中离家有点儿远，咱们换一个近点儿的房子吧。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoxuě de chūzhōng lí jiā yǒudiǎn er yuǎn, zánmen huàn yīgè jìn diǎn er de fángzǐ ba.
sentences.english: Xiaoxue's junior high school is a bit far from home. Let's change to a house closer.
sentences.spanish: La escuela secundaria de Xiaoxue está un poco lejos de casa. Cambiemos a una casa más cercana.

sentences.hanzi: 咱们换一个近点儿的房子吧。 / 咱们办张信用卡吧。
sentences.pinyin: zán men huàn yí ge jìn diǎn er de fáng zi ba / zán men bàn zhāng xìn yòng kǎ ba
sentences.english: Let's move to a house closer. / Let’s get a credit card.
sentences.spanish: Movámonos a una casa más cercana. / Consigamos una tarjeta de crédito.

sentences.hanzi: 咱们换一个近点儿的房子吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zánmen huàn yīgè jìn diǎn er de fángzǐ ba.
sentences.english: Let's move to a house closer.
sentences.spanish: Movámonos a una casa más cercana.

sentences.hanzi: 咱们换一个近点儿的房子吧。房子里面也不错。
sentences.pinyin: Zánmen huàn yīgè jìn diǎn er de fángzǐ ba. Fángzǐ lǐmiàn yě bùcuò.
sentences.english: Let's move to a house closer. The inside of the house is also nice.
sentences.spanish: Movámonos a una casa más cercana. El interior de la casa también es bonito.

sentences.hanzi: 你觉得这个小区怎么样？这个小区挺好的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ juédé zhège xiǎoqū zěnme yàng? Zhège xiǎoqū tǐng hǎo de.
sentences.english: What do you think of this neighborhood? This neighborhood is pretty good.
sentences.spanish: ¿Qué opinas de este barrio? Este barrio es bastante bueno.

sentences.hanzi: 环境挺好的，离地铁站还不远。
sentences.pinyin: Huánjìng tǐng hǎo de, lí dìtiě zhàn hái bù yuǎn.
sentences.english: The environment is very good, not far from the subway station.
sentences.spanish: El ambiente es muy bueno, no lejos de la estación de metro.

sentences.hanzi: 环境挺好的，离地铁站还不远。
sentences.pinyin: Huánjìng tǐng hǎo de, lí dìtiě zhàn hái bù yuǎn.
sentences.english: The environment is very good, not far from the subway station.
sentences.spanish: El ambiente es muy bueno, no lejos de la estación de metro.

sentences.hanzi: 房子里面也不错，空调和洗衣机都是新的。
sentences.pinyin: Fángzǐ lǐmiàn yě bùcuò, kòngtiáo hé xǐyījī dōu shì xīn de.
sentences.english: The inside of the house is also good, the air conditioner and washing machine are new.
sentences.spanish: El interior de la casa también es bueno, el aire acondicionado y la lavadora son nuevos.

sentences.hanzi: 空调和洗衣机都是新的。 / 洗衣机也坏了吗？
sentences.pinyin: kōng tiáo hé xǐ yī jī dōu shì xīn de / xǐ yī jī yě huài le ma
sentences.english: The air conditioner and washing machine are new. / Is the washing machine broken too?
sentences.spanish: El aire acondicionado y la lavadora son nuevos. / ¿La lavadora también está rota?

sentences.hanzi: 是不错，但是我不喜欢住一层。
sentences.pinyin: Shì bùcuò, dànshì wǒ bù xǐhuān zhù yī céng.
sentences.english: It's good, but I don't like living on the first floor.
sentences.spanish: Está bien, pero no me gusta vivir en el primer piso.

sentences.hanzi: 这个一层带一个小花园，我觉得咱们可以去看看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yī céng dài yīgè xiǎo huāyuán, wǒ juédé zánmen kěyǐ qù kàn kàn.
sentences.english: There is a small garden on this first floor, I think we can go and have a look.
sentences.spanish: Hay un pequeño jardín en este primer piso, creo que podemos ir a echar un vistazo.

sentences.hanzi: 我今天早上来的时候，灯还开着。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang lái de shíhòu, dēng hái kāizhe.
sentences.english: When I came this morning, the lights were still on.
sentences.spanish: Cuando llegué esta mañana, las luces todavía estaban encendidas.

sentences.hanzi: 我这几天忙坏了，可能走的时候忘关了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān máng huàile, kěnéng zǒu de shíhòu wàng guānle.
sentences.english: I've been so busy these days, I may have forgotten to turn it off when I left.
sentences.spanish: He estado tan ocupado estos días que tal vez me olvidé de apagarlo cuando me fui.

sentences.hanzi: 冰箱不能用，这些吃的东西放在哪儿？
sentences.pinyin: Bīngxiāng bùnéng yòng, zhèxiē chī de dōngxī fàng zài nǎ'er?
sentences.english: The refrigerator doesn't work. Where to put the food?
sentences.spanish: El frigorífico no funciona. ¿Dónde poner la comida?

sentences.hanzi: 卫生间没打扫好，还不能洗衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Wèishēngjiān méi dǎsǎo hǎo, hái bùnéng xǐ yīfú.
sentences.english: The bathroom was not cleaned properly and I couldn't do laundry.
sentences.spanish: El baño no estaba limpio adecuadamente y no podía lavar la ropa.

sentences.hanzi: 卫生间没打扫好，还不能洗衣服。 / 下周去打扫新家。
sentences.pinyin: wèi shēng jiān méi dǎ sǎo hǎo hái bù néng xǐ yī fu / xià zhōu qù dǎ sǎo xīn jiā
sentences.english: The bathroom was not cleaned properly and I couldn't do laundry. / Cleaning the new home next week.
sentences.spanish: El baño no estaba limpio adecuadamente y no podía lavar la ropa. / Limpiando la nueva casa la próxima semana.

sentences.hanzi: 星期天我们真的能搬家吗？ / 我觉得这个星期就能搬家。
sentences.pinyin: xīng qī tiān wǒ men zhēn de néng bān jiā ma / wǒ jué de zhè ge xīng qī jiù néng bān jiā
sentences.english: Can we really move on Sunday? / I think I can move this week.
sentences.spanish: ¿Podemos realmente mudarnos el domingo? / Creo que puedo mudarme esta semana.

sentences.hanzi: 咱们办张信用卡吧，花的钱可以慢慢还。
sentences.pinyin: Zánmen bàn zhāng xìnyòngkǎ ba, huā de qián kěyǐ màn man hái.
sentences.english: Let's get a credit card so that the money we spend can be paid back over time.
sentences.spanish: Consigamos una tarjeta de crédito para que el dinero que gastamos se pueda devolver con el tiempo.

sentences.hanzi: 咱们办张信用卡吧，花的钱可以慢慢还。
sentences.pinyin: Zánmen bàn zhāng xìnyòngkǎ ba, huā de qián kěyǐ màn man hái.
sentences.english: Let's get a credit card so that the money we spend can be paid back over time.
sentences.spanish: Consigamos una tarjeta de crédito para que el dinero que gastamos se pueda devolver con el tiempo.

sentences.hanzi: 咱们办张信用卡吧，花的钱可以慢慢还。
sentences.pinyin: Zánmen bàn zhāng xìnyòngkǎ ba, huā de qián kěyǐ màn man hái.
sentences.english: Let's get a credit card so that the money we spend can be paid back over time.
sentences.spanish: Consigamos una tarjeta de crédito para que el dinero que gastamos se pueda devolver con el tiempo.

sentences.hanzi: 听说中国银行的服务不错，办了信用卡买东西还能便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng shuō zhōngguó yínháng de fúwù bùcuò, bànle xìnyòngkǎ mǎi dōngxī hái néng piányí.
sentences.english: I heard that the services of Bank of China are good, and you can buy things cheaper if you get a credit card.
sentences.spanish: Escuché que los servicios del Banco de China son buenos y que puedes comprar cosas más baratas si obtienes una tarjeta de crédito.

sentences.hanzi: 中国银行很近，走路几分钟就能到。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngguó yínháng hěn jìn, zǒulù jǐ fēnzhōng jiù néng dào.
sentences.english: The Bank of China is very close, just a few minutes' walk away.
sentences.spanish: El Banco de China está muy cerca, a sólo unos minutos andando.

sentences.hanzi: 我下午要去医院，很晚才能回来。 / 我觉得下个月才能搬家。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yī yuàn hěn wǎn cái néng huí lai / wǒ jué de xià ge yuè cái néng bān jiā
sentences.english: I have to go to the hospital in the afternoon and won't be back until very late. / I don’t think I can move until next month.
sentences.spanish: Tengo que ir al hospital por la tarde y no volveré hasta muy tarde. / No creo que pueda mudarme hasta el próximo mes.

sentences.hanzi: 我明天去买一些纸箱，很快就能准备好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān qù mǎi yīxiē zhǐxiāng, hěn kuài jiù néng zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.english: I'm going to buy some cardboard boxes tomorrow and they'll be ready soon.
sentences.spanish: Mañana voy a comprar unas cajas de cartón y pronto estarán listas.

sentences.hanzi: 最多一天就能搬完。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìduō yītiān jiù néng bān wán.
sentences.english: The move can be completed in one day at most.
sentences.spanish: La mudanza se puede realizar en un día como máximo.

sentences.hanzi: 这么多事情最少需要两个星期才能做完。
sentences.pinyin: Zhème duō shìqíng zuìshǎo xūyào liǎng gè xīngqí cáinéng zuò wán.
sentences.english: It will take at least two weeks to complete so many things.
sentences.spanish: Se necesitarán al menos dos semanas para completar tantas cosas.

sentences.hanzi: 听说中国银行的服务不错，办了信用卡买东西还能便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng shuō zhōngguó yínháng de fúwù bùcuò, bànle xìnyòngkǎ mǎi dōngxī hái néng piányí.
sentences.english: I heard that the services of Bank of China are good, and you can buy things cheaper if you get a credit card.
sentences.spanish: Escuché que los servicios del Banco de China son buenos y que puedes comprar cosas más baratas si obtienes una tarjeta de crédito.

sentences.hanzi: 搬家那天，我们应该找一家搬家公司。
sentences.pinyin: Bānjiā nèitiān, wǒmen yīnggāi zhǎo yījiā bānjiā gōngsī.
sentences.english: On the moving day, we should find a moving company.
sentences.spanish: El día de la mudanza, debemos buscar una empresa de mudanzas.

sentences.hanzi: 我明天去买一些纸箱，很快就能准备好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān qù mǎi yīxiē zhǐxiāng, hěn kuài jiù néng zhǔnbèi hǎo.
sentences.english: I'm going to buy some cardboard boxes tomorrow and they'll be ready soon.
sentences.spanish: Mañana voy a comprar unas cajas de cartón y pronto estarán listas.

sentences.hanzi: 这个假期咱们去哪儿玩玩吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiàqī zánmen qù nǎ'er wán wán ba.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都很担心你。 / 别担心！听医生的话。

sentences.english: Everyone is worried about you. / don’t worry! Listen to your doctor.
sentences.spanish: Todo el mundo está preocupado por ti. / ¡no te preocupes! Escuche a su médico.

sentences.hanzi: 我的腿疼了几个星期了，医生说需要住院做检查。

sentences.hanzi: 你看起来一点儿也不像病人。

sentences.english: You look nothing like a patient.
sentences.spanish: No te pareces en nada a un paciente.

sentences.hanzi: 我上次来医院已经过去差不多两年了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì lái yīyuàn yǐjīng guòqù chàbùduō liǎng niánle.
sentences.english: It’s been almost two years since I last came to the hospital.
sentences.spanish: Han pasado casi dos años desde la última vez que vine al hospital.

sentences.hanzi: 但是还得做完检查才能知道。

sentences.english: But we still have to complete the examination to find out.
sentences.spanish: Pero todavía tenemos que completar el examen para averiguarlo.

sentences.hanzi: 有人来看我，我就开心多了。

sentences.spanish: Cuando alguien viene a verme me siento mucho más feliz.

sentences.pinyin: Chūyuàn qián, yīshēng gěi wǒ kāile jǐ zhǒng yào, érqiě gàosùle wǒ chī yào de fāngfǎ.

sentences.hanzi: 中国有一条大河，它的名字跟颜色有关系。

sentences.english: There is a big river in China, and its name is related to its color.
sentences.spanish: Hay un gran río en China y su nombre está relacionado con su color.

sentences.hanzi: 它的名字跟颜色有关系，你知道是什么河吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā de míngzì gēn yánsè yǒu guānxì, nǐ zhīdào shì shénme hé ma?
sentences.english: Its name is related to its color. Do you know what kind of river it is?

sentences.hanzi: 在我们中国人看来，黄河像妈妈一样，养了我们几千年。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǒmen zhōngguó rén kàn lái, huánghé xiàng māmā yīyàng, yǎngle wǒmen jǐ qiān nián.

sentences.spanish: A los ojos de los chinos, el río Amarillo es como una madre que nos nutre durante miles de años.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道，是黄河！黄河虽然不是最长的河，可是在历史上很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, shì huánghé! Huánghé suīrán bùshì zuì zhǎng de hé, kěshì zài lìshǐ shàng hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: I know, it’s the Yellow River! Although the Yellow River is not the longest river, it is very important in history.
sentences.spanish: ¡Lo sé, es el río Amarillo! Aunque el río Amarillo no es el río más largo, es muy importante en la historia.

sentences.hanzi: 有一条非常有名的河经过那里。

sentences.english: There is a very famous river passing there.
sentences.spanish: Por allí pasa un río muy famoso.

sentences.hanzi: 那里有高高的大树和绿绿的草地。

sentences.english: There are tall trees and green grass there.

sentences.english: Chat with the friends you meet, and the sad things will soon be forgotten.
sentences.spanish: Chatea con los amigos que conozcas y las cosas tristes pronto se olvidarán.

sentences.spanish: No sigas más, ha llegado la oficina del profesor Li. / Aprenderé más de gente seria en el futuro.

grammar.point: 固定短语“看上去 / 看起来”
grammar.name: Set Phrases "看上去 / 看起来" (Looks like / Seems)
grammar.formula: 看上去 / 看起来 + 形容词 / 状态小句
grammar.notes: Used to describe the apparent physical appearance, condition, or impression of a person or object.
grammar.examples:
1. 他们看上去有点儿像。
2. 这些菜看起来都很好吃。
3. 那个新来的老师看上去很年轻。
grammar.translations:
1. Tāmen kànshangqu yǒudiǎnr xiàng. (They look a bit alike.)
2. Zhèxiē cài kànqilai dōu hěn hǎochī. (These dishes look very delicious.)
3. Nàge xīn lái de lǎoshī kànshangqu hěn niánqīng. (That new teacher looks very young.)
grammar.spanishName: Frases hechas "看上去 / 看起来" (Parece / Parece)
grammar.spanishNotes: Se utiliza para describir la apariencia física aparente, condición o impresión de una persona u objeto.

grammar.point: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (1)
grammar.name: Non-Interrogative Use of Interrogative Pronouns (1) (Indefinite Reference)
grammar.formula: 主语 + 疑问代词 (哪儿 / 什么 / 谁 / 哪) + 动词短语
grammar.notes: Used in declarative sentences to refer to an unspecified or indefinite person, object, time, or place ("somewhere", "something", "someone", "some day") rather than asking a question.
grammar.examples:
1. 我好像在哪儿看到过这个箱子。
2. 你吃点儿什么再走吧。
3. 我们哪天一起去踢足球吧。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr kàndao guo zhège xiāngzi. (It seems I have seen this suitcase somewhere.)
2. Nǐ chī diǎnr shénme zài zǒu ba. (Eat something before you go.)
3. Wǒmen nǎ tiān yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú ba. (Let's play soccer together some day.)
grammar.spanishName: Uso no interrogativo de pronombres interrogativos (1) (referencia indefinida)
grammar.spanishNotes: Se utiliza en oraciones declarativas para referirse a una persona, objeto, tiempo o lugar no especificado o indefinido ("en algún lugar", "algo", "alguien", "algún día") en lugar de hacer una pregunta.

grammar.name: Multiple Attributives (Ordering of Noun Modifiers)
grammar.formula: 时间/处所 (Time/Loc) + 动作/状态 (Action/State) + 特点 (Characteristic) + 中心语 (Head Noun)
grammar.notes: When multiple modifiers describe a nominal head, they follow a natural hierarchy: Time/Location precedes Action/State, which precedes Characteristics/Qualities. Demonstrative/numeral phrases can precede or follow action modifiers.
grammar.examples:
1. 李文是那个穿着黑衣服的短头发的年轻人吗？
2. 昨天和家月一起看电影的两个人是我的朋友。
3. 我那件新买的白色的衣服在哪儿？
grammar.translations:
1. Lǐ Wén shì nàge chuānzhe hēi yīfu de duǎn tóufa de niánqīngrén ma? (Is Li Wen that short-haired young man in black?)
2. Zuótiān hé Jiāyuè yìqǐ kàn diànyǐng de liǎng ge rén shì wǒ de péngyou. (The two people who watched the movie with Jiayue yesterday are my friends.)
3. Wǒ nà jiàn xīn mǎi de báisè de yīfu zài nǎr? (Where is my newly bought white clothing?)
grammar.spanishName: Atributos múltiples (orden de modificadores de sustantivos)
grammar.spanishNotes: Cuando varios modificadores describen una cabeza nominal, siguen una jerarquía natural: Tiempo/Ubicación precede a Acción/Estado, que precede a Características/Cualidades. Las frases demostrativas/numéricas pueden preceder o seguir a los modificadores de acción.

grammar.name: Coordinate Complex Sentence "又……又……" (Both ... and ...)
grammar.formula: 又 + 形容词₁ + 又 + 形容词₂
grammar.notes: Used before adjectives to state that a person, object, or situation simultaneously possesses two characteristics (typically both positive or both negative).
grammar.examples:
1. 我现在还真是又饿又渴。
2. 那个女孩儿又高又漂亮。
3. 这个饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ xiànzài hái zhēnshi yòu è yòu kě. (Right now I'm truly both hungry and thirsty.)
2. Nàge nǚháir yòu gāo yòu piàoliang. (That girl is both tall and pretty.)
3. Zhège fànguǎn de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī. (The dishes here are both cheap and delicious.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja coordinada "又……又……" (Ambos... y...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Se utiliza antes de adjetivos para indicar que una persona, objeto o situación posee simultáneamente dos características (normalmente ambas positivas o ambas negativas).

grammar.point: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (2)
grammar.name: Non-Interrogative Use of Interrogative Pronouns (2) (Universal Reference)
grammar.formula: 疑问代词 (哪 / 哪儿 / 什么 / 谁 / 怎么) + 都 / 也 + 谓语
grammar.notes: Expresses universal / general reference ("anyone", "anything", "anywhere", "in any way"). Paired with the adverb 都 or 也 to indicate all entities in the scope share the attribute.
grammar.examples:
1. 哪个菜都好吃。
2. 这次旅游，我去哪儿都可以。
3. 我下午有时间，你想什么时候来都没问题。
grammar.translations:
1. Nǎge cài dōu hǎochī. (Every dish is delicious / Any dish is good.)
2. Zhè cì lǚyóu, wǒ qù nǎr dōu kěyǐ. (For this trip, I can go anywhere.)
3. Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu shíjiān, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou lái dōu méi wèntí. (Coming whenever you want is completely fine.)
grammar.spanishName: Uso no interrogativo de pronombres interrogativos (2) (referencia universal)
grammar.spanishNotes: Expresa referencia universal/general ("cualquiera", "cualquier cosa", "en cualquier lugar", "de cualquier manera"). Emparejado con el adverbio 都 o 也 para indicar que todas las entidades en el alcance comparten el atributo.

grammar.point: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (3)
grammar.name: Non-Interrogative Use of Interrogative Pronouns (3) (Paired Arbitrary Pronouns)
grammar.formula: Clause 1 [疑问代词] + 就 + Clause 2 [相同疑问代词]
grammar.notes: Two identical interrogative pronouns echo each other across clauses, referring to the exact same entity, action, time, or location ("whichever / whatever you like"). If subjects differ, the second subject precedes 就.
grammar.examples:
1. 你们想吃什么就点什么。
2. 你觉得哪个好看就买哪个。
3. 你想去哪儿，我们就去哪儿。
grammar.translations:
1. Nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme. (Order whatever you feel like eating.)
2. Nǐ juéde nǎge hǎokàn jiù mǎi nǎge. (Buy whichever one you think looks nice.)
3. Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr, wǒmen jiù qù nǎr. (Wherever you want to go, we will go there.)
grammar.spanishName: Uso no interrogativo de pronombres interrogativos (3) (pronombres arbitrarios emparejados)
grammar.spanishNotes: Dos pronombres interrogativos idénticos se repiten entre sí en las cláusulas, refiriéndose exactamente a la misma entidad, acción, tiempo o ubicación ("lo que quieras"). Si los temas difieren, el segundo tema precede a 就.

grammar.name: Adverb of Degree "挺" (Quite / Rather / Pretty)
grammar.formula: 挺 + 形容词 / 心理动词 + 的
grammar.notes: Precedes adjectives or psychological verbs to express a high degree in colloquial speech, typically ending with the modal particle 的.
grammar.examples:
1. 这个小区环境挺好的。
2. 这家饭馆的菜挺好吃的。
3. 买这个吧，我挺喜欢这个颜色的。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhège xiǎoqū huánjìng tǐng hǎo de. (The surroundings of this complex are quite nice.)
2. Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài tǐng hǎochī de. (The dishes at this restaurant are pretty tasty.)
3. Mǎi zhège ba, wǒ tǐng xǐhuan zhège yánsè de. (Let's buy this; I quite like this color.)
grammar.spanishName: Adverbio de grado "挺" (Bastante / Más bien / Bonita)
grammar.spanishNotes: Precede a adjetivos o verbos psicológicos para expresar un alto grado en el habla coloquial, y normalmente termina con la partícula modal 的.

grammar.name: Complement of Degree (1) "坏了" (Extremely / To death)
grammar.formula: 形容词 + 坏了
grammar.notes: Placed after adjectives to express an extremely high, exaggerated degree of intensity. Primarily used in negative or taxing contexts ("swamped", "exhausted", "starving").
grammar.examples:
1. 我这几天忙坏了。
2. 我渴坏了，哪里能买水？
3. 这几天非常忙，大家都累坏了。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān máng huài le. (I've been swamped / busy to death these past few days.)
2. Wǒ kě huài le, nǎlǐ néng mǎi shuǐ? (I'm terribly thirsty; where can I buy water?)
3. Zhè jǐ tiān fēicháng máng, dàjiā dōu lèi huài le. (Everyone is exhausted from being so busy.)
grammar.spanishName: Complemento de Grado (1) "坏了" (Extremadamente / Hasta la muerte)
grammar.spanishNotes: Colocado después de adjetivos para expresar un grado de intensidad extremadamente alto y exagerado. Se utiliza principalmente en contextos negativos o agotadores ("inundado", "agotado", "muerto de hambre").

grammar.name: Comparison of "就" and "才" (Subjective Timing & Ease)
grammar.formula:
• 时间/条件 + 就 + 动词 (Early / Fast / Smooth)
• 时间/条件 + 才 + 动词 (Late / Slow / Delayed)
grammar.notes:
Expresses the speaker's subjective perspective:
• 就: Action occurs early, quickly, or smoothly ("as early as", "right away").
• 才: Action occurs late, slowly, with delay or difficulty ("not until", "only then").
grammar.examples:
1. 中国银行很近，走路几分钟就能到。
2. 我下午要去医院，很晚才能回来。
3. 我早上五点就起床了。
4. 坐火车去北京，五个小时才能到。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhōngguó Yínháng hěn jìn, zǒulù jǐ fēnzhōng jiù néng dào. (The bank is close; you can get there in just a few minutes.)
2. Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù yīyuàn, hěn wǎn cái néng huílái. (I have to go to hospital and won't return until late.)
3. Wǒ zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le. (I got up as early as 5:00 a.m.)
4. Zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng, wǔ ge xiǎoshí cái néng dào. (By train to Beijing, it takes five hours to arrive.)
grammar.spanishName: Comparación de "就" y "才" (Tiempo y facilidad subjetivos)
grammar.spanishNotes:
Expresa la perspectiva subjetiva del hablante:
• 就: La acción ocurre temprano, rápidamente o sin problemas ("tan pronto como", "inmediatamente").
• 才: La acción ocurre tarde, lentamente, con retraso o dificultad ("no hasta", "sólo entonces").

grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '一……也/都+不/没……' (Complete Negation)
grammar.formula: 一 + 量词/一点儿 + 名词 + 也/都 + 不/没 + 动词/形容词
grammar.notes: Expresses complete negation ('not at all', 'not even one'). When modifying an adjective, '一点儿也/都+不/没+形容词' is commonly used.
grammar.examples:
1. 她一件衣服都不想买。
2. 我一个中国电影也没看过。
3. 草原一点儿也不冷。
4. 他们一点儿也没着急。
grammar.translations:
1. Tā yí jiàn yīfu dōu bù xiǎng mǎi. (She doesn't want to buy even a single piece of clothing.)
2. Wǒ yí ge Zhōngguó diànyǐng yě méi kànguo. (I haven't watched even one Chinese movie.)
3. Cǎoyuán yìdiǎnr yě bù lěng. (The grasslands aren't cold at all.)
4. Tāmen yìdiǎnr yě méi zháojí. (They weren't anxious in the least.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '一……也/都+不/没……' (Negación completa)
grammar.spanishNotes: Expresa negación total (“en absoluto”, “ni siquiera uno”). Al modificar un adjetivo, se usa comúnmente '一点儿也/都+不/没+形容词'.

grammar.name: Comparative Sentences (9) 'A跟B一样' (Equivalence)
grammar.formula:
A + 跟 + B + 一样 (+ 形容词)
否定: A + 跟 + B + 不一样 (+ 形容词)
grammar.notes: Indicates that A and B are the same or equal upon comparison. An adjective can follow to specify the dimension of comparison. Negative form places '不' before '一样'.
grammar.examples:
1. 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样。
2. 他买的新手机跟我的一样。
3. 这个房间跟那个房间一样大。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhè jiā bīnguǎn gēn biéde dōu bù yíyàng. (This hotel is unlike any other.)
2. Tā mǎi de xīn shǒujī gēn wǒ de yíyàng. (The new phone he bought is the same as mine.)
3. Zhège fángjiān gēn nàge fángjiān yíyàng dà. (This room is just as large as that one.)
grammar.spanishName: Oraciones comparativas (9) 'A跟B一样' (Equivalencia)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica que A y B son iguales o iguales en comparación. Puede seguir un adjetivo para especificar la dimensión de comparación. La forma negativa coloca '不' antes de '一样'.

grammar.point: 固定格式“除了……(以外)，……都/还/也……”
grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '除了……(以外)，……都/还/也……' (Exclusion & Addition)
grammar.formula:
• 排除 (Exclusion): 除了A (以外)，(其他/别的) + 都 + 谓语
• 补充 (Addition): 除了A (以外)，(主语) + 还/也 + 谓语
grammar.notes:
• With 都: Excludes A from a group where all others share the same condition ('except for A').
• With 还/也: Excludes A to add more items to the scope ('in addition to A / besides A').
grammar.examples:
1. 除了我以外，大家都在玩手机。
2. 除了这个汉字，别的汉字我都会写。
3. 除了这个行李箱以外，还有别的东西吗？
4. 除了唱歌以外，他也喜欢跳舞。
grammar.translations:
1. Chúle wǒ yǐwài, dàjiā dōu zài wán shǒujī. (Except for me, everyone is on their phones.)
2. Chúle zhège hànzì, biéde hànzì wǒ dōu huì xiě. (Except this character, I can write all the others.)
3. Chúle zhège xínglixiāng yǐwài, hái yǒu biéde dōngxi ma? (Besides this suitcase, is there anything else?)
4. Chúle chànggē yǐwài, tā yě xǐhuan tiàowǔ. (Besides singing, he also likes dancing.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '除了……(以外),……都/还/也……' (Exclusión y adición)
grammar.spanishNotes:
• Con 都: Excluye a A de un grupo donde todos los demás comparten la misma condición ('excepto A').
• Con 还/也: Excluye A para agregar más elementos al alcance ('además de A / además de A').

grammar.name: Complement of Degree (2) '得很' (Extremely / Very)
grammar.formula: 形容词 + 得很
grammar.notes: Used after an adjective in colloquial speech to indicate an extremely high degree ('very / terribly / awfully').
grammar.examples:
1. 现在天气好得很。
2. 房间里面热得很。
3. 我觉得爬山累得很。
grammar.translations:
1. Xiànzài tiānqì hǎo de hěn. (The weather right now is wonderfully good.)
2. Fángjiān lǐmiàn rè de hěn. (It is terribly hot inside the room.)
3. Wǒ juéde páshān lèi de hěn. (I think hiking is awfully exhausting.)
grammar.spanishName: Complemento de Grado (2) '得很' (Muy/Mucho)
grammar.spanishNotes: Se usa después de un adjetivo en el habla coloquial para indicar un grado extremadamente alto ('muy/terriblemente/horriblemente').

grammar.name: Reduplication of Measure Words (Every single one)
grammar.formula: 量词重叠 (AA) + 都 + 谓语
grammar.notes: Reduplicating a measure word emphasizes that every single member within a scope possesses the quality without exception ('every / each and every').
grammar.examples:
1. 这些照片张张都非常好看。(= 每张都好看)
2. 这些苹果个个都很大。(= 每个都很大)
3. 我想出去拍照，但是天天下雨。(= 每天都下雨)
grammar.translations:
1. Zhèxiē zhàopiàn zhāngzhāng dōu fēicháng hǎokàn. (Every single one of these photos is beautiful.)
2. Zhèxiē píngguǒ gègè dōu hěn dà. (Every single one of these apples is big.)
3. Wǒ xiǎng chūqu pāizhào, dànshì tiāntiān xiàyǔ. (I want to go take photos, but it rains every day.)
grammar.spanishName: Reduplicación de palabras de medida (cada una)
grammar.spanishNotes: La duplicación de una palabra de medida enfatiza que cada miembro dentro de un alcance posee la cualidad sin excepción ("todos / todos y cada uno").

grammar.name: Existential Sentences (3) (Appearance / Disappearance)
grammar.formula: 处所词语 + 动词 + 趋向补语/结果补语 + (动态助词) + 数量短语 + 人/物
grammar.notes: Describes the emergence, appearance, or disappearance of people or things at a particular location.
grammar.examples:
1. 后边走过去两个人。
2. 前面开过来很多车。
3. 楼上下来了几个人。
grammar.translations:
1. Hòubian zǒu guòqu liǎng ge rén. (Two people walked past from behind.)
2. Qiánmian kāi guòlai hěn duō chē. (Many cars drove over from the front.)
3. Lóushang xiàlai le jǐ ge rén. (Several people came down from upstairs.)
grammar.spanishName: Oraciones Existenciales (3) (Aparición/Desaparición)
grammar.spanishNotes: Describe el surgimiento, aparición o desaparición de personas o cosas en un lugar particular.

grammar.name: Contracted Complex Sentence '……了就……' (Immediate Succession)
grammar.formula: 动词₁ + 了…… + 就 + 动词₂……(+ 了)
grammar.notes: Indicates that the second action occurs immediately following the completion of the first. If both are already completed, a final '了' is added.
grammar.examples:
1. 你听完了音乐会就来我家吃饭。
2. 我吃了早饭就去学校了。
3. 昨天我们下了课就回家了。
grammar.translations:
1. Nǐ tīngwán le yīnyuèhuì jiù lái wǒ jiā chīfàn. (Come to my house for dinner right after the concert finishes.)
2. Wǒ chī le zǎofàn jiù qù xuéxiào le. (I went to school right after eating breakfast.)
3. Zuótiān wǒmen xià le kè jiù huíjiā le. (Yesterday we went home right after class ended.)
grammar.spanishName: Sentencia Compleja Contraída '……了就……' (Sucesión Inmediata)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica que la segunda acción ocurre inmediatamente después de la finalización de la primera. Si ambos ya están completos, se agrega un '了' final.

grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '该……了' (It's Time To...)
grammar.formula: 该 + 动词短语 + 了
grammar.notes: Indicates that it is time to perform an action or that an obligation is due, widely used in spoken Chinese.
grammar.examples:
1. 咱们该买去上海的票了。
2. 八点了，该上课了。
3. 已经很晚了，我该睡觉了。
grammar.translations:
1. Zánmen gāi mǎi qù Shànghǎi de piào le. (It's time for us to buy the tickets to Shanghai.)
2. Bā diǎn le, gāi shàngkè le. (It's 8:00; time to start class.)
3. Yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, wǒ gāi shuìjiào le. (It's already very late; I should go to sleep.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '该……了' (Es hora de...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica que es momento de realizar una acción o que se debe una obligación, muy utilizado en el chino hablado.

grammar.name: Hypothetical Complex Sentence '如果……，就……' (If... then...)
grammar.formula: 如果 + 假设小句，(主语) + 就 + 结果分句
grammar.notes: Introduces a condition or premise after '如果', with the resulting action or outcome introduced by '就'. Second subject precedes '就'.
grammar.examples:
1. 如果没走错，二十分钟以前就到了。
2. 如果你需要帮忙，就给我打电话。
3. 如果有时间，我就去上海玩几天。
grammar.translations:
1. Rúguǒ méi zǒucuò, èrshí fēnzhōng yǐqián jiù dào le. (If we hadn't taken the wrong turn, we would have arrived 20 minutes ago.)
2. Rúguǒ nǐ xūyào bāngmáng, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà. (If you need help, just call me.)
3. Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù Shànghǎi wán jǐ tiān. (If I have time, I will go spend a few days in Shanghai.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración hipotética compleja '如果……，就……' (Si... entonces...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Introduce una condición o premisa después de '如果', con la acción o resultado resultante introducido por '就'. El segundo sujeto precede a '就'.

grammar.name: Set Phrase '越来越……' (More and More...)
grammar.formula: 越来越 + 形容词 / 心理动词
grammar.notes: Denotes an ongoing progressive increase in degree over time. Cannot be modified by other degree adverbs like 很 or 非常.
grammar.examples:
1. 前面的人越来越多。
2. 我越来越喜欢这里的生活了。
3. 她越来越高，也越来越漂亮了。
grammar.translations:
1. Qiánmian de rén yuèláiyuè duō. (There are more and more people ahead.)
2. Wǒ yuèláiyuè xǐhuan zhèlǐ de shēnghuó le. (I like living here more and more.)
3. Tā yuèláiyuè gāo, yě yuèláiyuè piàoliang le. (She is getting taller and prettier.)
grammar.spanishName: Frase establecida '越来越……' (Más y más...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Denota un aumento progresivo y continuo de grado a lo largo del tiempo. No puede modificarse con otros adverbios de grado como 很 o 非常.

grammar.name: Serial Verb Sentences (2) (Manner with '着')
grammar.formula: 动词₁ + 着 + (宾语₁) + 动词₂ + (宾语₂)
grammar.notes: The aspect particle '着' after the first verb indicates the manner, accompanying posture, or ongoing state while performing the second action.
grammar.examples:
1. 咱们可以走着去。
2. 弟弟吃着苹果写作业。
3. 他们坐着看电视。
grammar.translations:
1. Zánmen kěyǐ zǒuzhe qù. (We can go there on foot / walking.)
2. Dìdi chīzhe píngguǒ xiě zuòyè. (Little brother is doing homework while eating an apple.)
3. Tāmen zuòzhe kàn diànshì. (They are sitting watching television.)
grammar.spanishName: Oraciones verbales en serie (2) (forma con '着')
grammar.spanishNotes: La partícula de aspecto '着' después del primer verbo indica la manera, la postura que lo acompaña o el estado en curso mientras se realiza la segunda acción.

grammar.name: Comparative Sentences (10) 'A不比B+形容词' (Not Much Difference / Refutation)
grammar.formula: A + 不比 + B + 形容词 (+ 多少/程度短语)
grammar.notes: Indicates that A is not more [adjective] than B (about the same). Often used to refute someone's claim or minimize a difference.
grammar.examples:
1. 裙子不比短裤贵多少。
2. 他的中文不比你好。
3. 他跑得不比我快多少。
grammar.translations:
1. Qúnzi bù bǐ duǎnkù guì duōshao. (The skirt isn't much more expensive than the shorts.)
2. Tā de Zhōngwén bù bǐ nǐ hǎo. (His Chinese is not better than yours.)
3. Tā pǎo de bù bǐ wǒ kuài duōshao. (He doesn't run much faster than me.)
grammar.spanishName: Oraciones comparativas (10) 'A不比B+形容词' (No hay mucha diferencia/refutación)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica que A no es más [adjetivo] que B (más o menos igual). A menudo se utiliza para refutar la afirmación de alguien o minimizar una diferencia.

grammar.name: Complement of Degree (3) '极了' (Extremely)
grammar.formula: 形容词 / 心理动词 + 极了
grammar.notes: Placed after an adjective or psychological verb to convey the utmost or extreme degree of a quality or feeling.
grammar.examples:
1. 这块冰西瓜甜极了。
2. 今年夏天热极了。
3. 这本书我喜欢极了。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhè kuài bīng xīguā tián jí le. (This chilled watermelon is extremely sweet.)
2. Jīnnián xiàtiān rè jí le. (This summer is extremely hot.)
3. Zhè běn shū wǒ xǐhuan jí le. (I like this book to bits / very much.)
grammar.spanishName: Complemento de Grado (3) '极了' (Extremadamente)
grammar.spanishNotes: Colocado después de un adjetivo o verbo psicológico para transmitir el grado máximo o extremo de una cualidad o sentimiento.

grammar.name: Progressive Complex Sentence '不但……，而且……' (Not only... but also...)
grammar.formula:
• 同主语: 主语 + 不但……，而且……
• 异主语: 不但 + 主语₁……，而且 + 主语₂……
grammar.notes: Connects clauses indicating progression in scope or degree. If subjects are identical, 不但 sits after the subject; if different, 不但 precedes the first subject.
grammar.examples:
1. 现在的电视不但便宜，而且用着非常方便。
2. 家月不但喜欢唱歌，而且唱得很好听。
3. 不但家月会说汉语，而且天中也会说汉语。
grammar.translations:
1. Xiànzài de diànshì búdàn piányi, érqiě yòngzhe fēicháng fāngbiàn. (Modern TVs are not only cheap, but also very convenient to use.)
2. Jiāyuè búdàn xǐhuan chànggē, érqiě chàng de hěn hǎotīng. (Jiayue not only likes singing, but sings very nicely.)
3. Búdàn Jiāyuè huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě Tiānzhōng yě huì shuō Hànyǔ. (Not only Jiayue can speak Chinese, but Tianzhong can too.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja progresiva '不但……，而且……' (No sólo... sino también...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Conecta cláusulas que indican progresión en alcance o grado. Si los sujetos son idénticos, 不但 se sienta después del sujeto; si es diferente, 不但 precede al primer sujeto.

grammar.point: 趋向补语的引申用法(1) “下去”
grammar.name: Extended Use of Directional Complement (1) '下去' (Continuation)
grammar.formula: 动词 / 形容词 + 下去
grammar.notes: Indicates that an ongoing action or state will continue into the future ('keep on doing', 'continue to be').
grammar.examples:
1. 我今年胖了十多斤，不能再胖下去了。
2. 她读完了第一个问题，后面的你读下去。
3. 这几天太热了，如果再热下去就不能出门了。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ jīnnián pàng le shí duō jīn, bù néng zài pàng xiàqu le. (I gained over 10 jin this year; I can't keep getting fatter.)
2. Tā dúwán le dì-yī ge wèntí, hòumian de nǐ dú xiàqu. (She read the first question; you continue reading the rest.)
3. Zhè jǐ tiān tài rè le, rúguǒ zài rè xiàqu jiù bù néng chūmén le. (If it keeps getting hotter, we won't be able to go out.)
grammar.spanishName: Uso ampliado del complemento direccional (1) '下去' (Continuación)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica que una acción o estado en curso continuará en el futuro ("seguir haciendo", "continuar siendo").

grammar.name: Separable Words (2) (Complements inserted in the middle)
grammar.formula: 动词语素 + 补语/量词 + 宾语语素 (如：游完泳、睡一觉、洗个澡)
grammar.notes: Separable words (verb-object compound words) cannot directly take objects. Complements of result, duration, or frequency must be inserted in between.
grammar.examples:
1. 昨天游完泳以后，我的耳朵一直有点儿疼。
2. 我先回去睡一觉，可能休息休息就好了。
3. 今年夏天只下了两次雨。
grammar.translations:
1. Zuótiān yóuwán yǒng yǐhòu, wǒ de ěrduo yìzhí yǒudiǎnr téng. (After finishing swimming yesterday, my ear kept hurting.)
2. Wǒ xiān huíqu shuì yí jiào, kěnéng xiūxi xiūxi jiù hǎo le. (I'll go home and take a nap first; maybe I'll feel better.)
3. Jīnnián xiàtiān zhǐ xià le liǎng cì yǔ. (It only rained twice this summer.)
grammar.spanishName: Palabras Separables (2) (Complementos insertados en el medio)
grammar.spanishNotes: Las palabras separables (palabras compuestas de verbo y objeto) no pueden tomar objetos directamente. Entremedias deberán intercalarse complementos de resultado, duración o frecuencia.

grammar.point: 时量补语(2) 非延续性动词
grammar.name: Complement of Duration (2) Non-Durative Verbs (Time elapsed since)
grammar.formula: 非延续性动词 + (了) + 时量短语 + (了)
grammar.notes: When used with instantaneous/non-durative verbs (like 来, 离开, 毕业, 结婚), the duration phrase indicates how much time has passed since the action finished.
grammar.examples:
1. 我上次来医院已经过去差不多两年了。
2. 她回家两个月了。
3. 开学已经三个多星期了。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ shàng cì lái yīyuàn yǐjīng guòqu chàbuduō liǎng nián le. (It has been nearly two years since I last came to the hospital.)
2. Tā huíjiā liǎng ge yuè le. (It has been two months since she returned home.)
3. Kāixué yǐjīng sān ge duō xīngqī le. (School has been in session for over three weeks already.)
grammar.spanishName: Complemento de Duración (2) Verbos No Durativos (Tiempo transcurrido desde)
grammar.spanishNotes: Cuando se usa con verbos instantáneos/no durativos (como 来, 离开, 毕业, 结婚), la frase de duración indica cuánto tiempo ha pasado desde que finalizó la acción.

grammar.point: 固定格式“……以前/以后/前/后”
grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '……以前/以后/前/后' (Before / After)
grammar.formula:
• 时间/事件 + 以前 / 前 (Before)
• 时间/事件 + 以后 / 后 (After)
grammar.notes: Specifies a point in time prior to or following a specific event or temporal reference.
grammar.examples:
1. 这种药需要每天睡前吃一次。
2. 我们决定下班后一起去看个电影。
3. 考完试以后，咱们一起去旅游吧。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhè zhǒng yào xūyào měitiān shuìqián chī yí cì. (This medicine needs to be taken once before bed daily.)
2. Wǒmen juédìng xiàbānhòu yìqǐ qù kàn ge diànyǐng. (We decided to go watch a movie together after work.)
3. Kǎowán shì yǐhòu, zánmen yìqǐ qù lǚyóu ba. (Let's travel together after finishing the exams.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '……以前/以后/前/后' (Antes / Después)
grammar.spanishNotes: Especifica un momento anterior o posterior a un evento específico o referencia temporal.

grammar.name: Purpose Complex Sentence '为了……' (In order to / For the sake of)
grammar.formula:
为了 + 目的，主语 + 采取行动
(或：主语 + 为了 + 目的，采取行动)
grammar.notes: The clause following '为了' states the intended objective or purpose, while the main clause describes the action taken toward that goal.
grammar.examples:
1. 听说为了准备运动会，你们几个男生每天都练球。
2. 为了考上大学，她每天努力学习。
3. 为了早点儿到家，我打算坐飞机回去。
grammar.translations:
1. Tīngshuō wèile zhǔnbèi yùndònghuì, nǐmen jǐ ge nánshēng měitiān dōu liàn qiú. (I heard that to prepare for the sports meet, you boys practice ball daily.)
2. Wèile kǎoshàng dàxué, tā měitiān nǔlì xuéxí. (In order to get into college, she studies hard every day.)
3. Wèile zǎodiǎnr dào jiā, wǒ dǎsuàn zuò fēijī huíqu. (To arrive home earlier, I plan to fly back.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja de propósito '为了……' (Para / Por el bien de)
grammar.spanishNotes: La cláusula que sigue a '为了' establece el objetivo o propósito previsto, mientras que la cláusula principal describe la acción tomada hacia ese objetivo.

grammar.name: Complement of Potentiality (Ability to achieve result)
grammar.formula:
• 肯定: 动词 + 得 + 结果/趋向补语
• 否定: 动词 + 不 + 结果/趋向补语
• 疑问: 动词+得+补语+动词+不+补语 / 动词+得+补语+吗
grammar.notes: Inserts '得' or '不' between a verb and its result/direction complement to indicate whether conditions permit achieving the result.
grammar.examples:
1. 不是比赛，打不好没关系。
2. 这本书你看得懂看不懂？
3. 你只有一个星期的时间，学得会游泳吗？
grammar.translations:
1. Bú shì bǐsài, dǎ bu hǎo méi guānxi. (It's not a match; it doesn't matter if you can't play well.)
2. Zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bu dǒng? (Can you understand this book?)
3. Nǐ zhǐyǒu yí ge xīngqī de shíjiān, xué de huì yóuyǒng ma? (With only one week, can you manage to learn swimming?)
grammar.spanishName: Complemento de Potencialidad (Capacidad para lograr resultado)
grammar.spanishNotes: Inserta '得' o '不' entre un verbo y su complemento de resultado/dirección para indicar si las condiciones permiten lograr el resultado.

grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '越A越B' (The more A, the more B)
grammar.formula: 越 + A (动词/形容词) + 越 + B (动词/形容词)
grammar.notes: Indicates that B changes in degree along with the change or progression of A ('the more... the more...').
grammar.examples:
1. 今天的足球比赛我越看越着急。
2. 妈妈越说，他越不高兴。
3. 我想认识中国朋友，越多越好。
grammar.translations:
1. Jīntiān de zúqiú bǐsài wǒ yuè kàn yuè zháojí. (The more I watched today's football match, the more anxious I felt.)
2. Māmā yuè shuō, tā yuè bù gāoxìng. (The more mom talked, the unhappier he became.)
3. Wǒ xiǎng rènshi Zhōngguó péngyou, yuè duō yuè hǎo. (I want to make Chinese friends; the more the better.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '越A越B' (Cuanto más A, más B)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica que B cambia de grado junto con el cambio o progresión de A ('cuanto más... más...').

grammar.name: '把' Sentence (1) (Positional Displacement)
grammar.formula: 主语 + (不/没/能愿动词) + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 在/到 + 地点
grammar.notes: Describes an action performed on a specific, definite object resulting in its change of physical position or location.
grammar.examples:
1. 我会把这些题都记在本子上。
2. 老师把作业本放到桌子上了。
3. 你不能把名字写在这里。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ huì bǎ zhèxiē tí dōu jì zài běnzi shang. (I will write all these questions down in my notebook.)
2. Lǎoshī bǎ zuòyèběn fàng dào zhuōzi shang le. (The teacher placed the exercise books onto the table.)
3. Nǐ bù néng bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhèlǐ. (You cannot write your name here.)
grammar.spanishName: '把' Oración (1) (Desplazamiento posicional)
grammar.spanishNotes: Describe una acción realizada sobre un objeto específico y definido que resulta en su cambio de posición o ubicación física.

grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '在……上/中/下' (Scope / Context / Condition)
grammar.formula:
• 在 + 名词 + 上 (In terms of / Within scope)
• 在 + 名词 + 中 (In the course of / During)
• 在 + 定语+动词 + 下 (Under the condition/help/influence of)
grammar.notes:
• 在...上 denotes scope or domain (learning, work).
• 在...中 denotes environment or ongoing process.
• 在...下 denotes condition, guidance, or influence.
grammar.examples:
1. 在学习上，遇到什么问题都可以问我。
2. 在比赛中，他得分最高。
3. 在老师的帮助下，我的成绩提高很快。
grammar.translations:
1. Zài xuéxí shang, yùdào shénme wèntí dōu kěyǐ wèn wǒ. (In terms of studies, feel free to ask me any question.)
2. Zài bǐsài zhōng, tā défēn zuì gāo. (In the competition, he scored the highest points.)
3. Zài lǎoshī de bāngzhù xià, wǒ de chéngjì tígāo hěn kuài. (Under the teacher's help, my grades improved rapidly.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '在……上/中/下' (Alcance / Contexto / Condición)
grammar.spanishNotes:
• 在...上 denota alcance o dominio (aprendizaje, trabajo).
• 在...中 denota entorno o proceso en curso.
• 在...下 denota condición, guía o influencia.

grammar.name: '把' Sentence (2) (Relational Transfer / Giving)
grammar.formula: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 给 + 接收对象
grammar.notes: Describes an action causing a definite item to transfer in possession or relationship to another recipient (using '给').
grammar.examples:
1. 你明天再把书还给我。
2. 我把礼物送给她了。
3. 请你把这本书带给老师。
grammar.translations:
1. Nǐ míngtiān zài bǎ shū huán gěi wǒ. (You can return the book to me tomorrow.)
2. Wǒ bǎ lǐwù sòng gěi tā le. (I gave the gift to her.)
3. Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè běn shū dài gěi lǎoshī. (Please take this book to the teacher.)
grammar.spanishName: '把' Oración (2) (Transferencia relacional / Dar)
grammar.spanishNotes: Describe una acción que hace que un artículo definido se transfiera en posesión o relación a otro destinatario (usando '给').

grammar.name: Comparison of '还是' and '或者' (Or: Questions vs. Declaratives)
grammar.formula:
• 疑问句 (Question): A + 还是 + B？
• 陈述句 (Statement): A + 或者 + B
grammar.notes: '还是' presents alternatives in interrogative sentences requiring a choice. '或者' presents options in declarative statements.
grammar.examples:
1. 我们用会议室的电脑还是自己的笔记本电脑？
2. 会议室的电脑或者自己的电脑都可以。
3. 你可以坐地铁或者打车去学校。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒmen yòng huìyìshì de diànnǎo háishi zìjǐ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo? (Shall we use the conference computer or our own laptops?)
2. Huìyìshì de diànnǎo huòzhě zìjǐ de diànnǎo dōu kěyǐ. (Either the conference room's computer or your own is fine.)
3. Nǐ kěyǐ zuò dìtiě huòzhě dǎchē qù xuéxiào. (You can take the subway or take a taxi to school.)
grammar.spanishName: Comparación de '还是' y '或者' (O: preguntas versus declarativos)
grammar.spanishNotes: '还是' presenta alternativas en oraciones interrogativas que requieren una elección. '或者' presenta opciones en declaraciones declarativas.

grammar.name: Set Phrase '看来' (It seems / Apparently)
grammar.formula: 看来 + 观察推测得出的结论分句
grammar.notes: Used at the start of a clause to introduce a deduction, evaluation, or inference drawn from observed facts or reflection.
grammar.examples:
1. 看来我没办法解决这个问题。
2. 这么晚了，看来他今天不会来了。
3. 电梯坏了，看来咱们只能走下去了。
grammar.translations:
1. Kànlái wǒ méi bànfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí. (It seems I have no way to solve this problem.)
2. Zhème wǎn le, kànlái tā jīntiān bú huì lái le. (It's so late; it looks like he won't be coming today.)
3. Diàntī huài le, kànlái zánmen zhǐ néng zǒu xiàqu le. (The elevator is broken; looks like we can only walk down.)
grammar.spanishName: Frase establecida '看来' (Parece / Aparentemente)
grammar.spanishNotes: Se utiliza al comienzo de una cláusula para introducir una deducción, evaluación o inferencia extraída de hechos observados o reflexión.

grammar.name: '把' Sentence (3) (Producing a Result)
grammar.formula: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 结果补语 (如：完、好、干净、错)
grammar.notes: Indicates that an action executed on a definite entity causes a concrete final state or outcome (indicated by the result complement).
grammar.examples:
1. 我跟您一起把这些工作做完。
2. 妈妈把衣服洗干净了。
3. 他还没把笔记本电脑接好呢。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ gēn nín yìqǐ bǎ zhèxiē gōngzuò zuòwán. (I will finish this work together with you.)
2. Māmā bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng le. (Mom washed the clothes clean.)
3. Tā hái méi bǎ bǐjìběn diànnǎo jiēhǎo ne. (He hasn't finished connecting the laptop properly yet.)
grammar.spanishName: '把' Oración (3) (Produciendo un resultado)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica que una acción ejecutada sobre una entidad definida provoca un estado o resultado final concreto (indicado por el complemento de resultado).

grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '对……来说' (From the perspective of / For...)
grammar.formula: 对 + 人/群体 + 来说，观点/态度/陈述
grammar.notes: Identifies the specific target person or group from whose perspective a judgment, feeling, or viewpoint applies ('as for...', 'to...').
grammar.examples:
1. 对我来说，生活也很重要，我不愿意为工作离开家人。
2. 对她来说，学习汉语很有意思。
3. 对孩子来说，玩也是一种学习。
grammar.translations:
1. Duì wǒ lái shuō, shēnghuó yě hěn zhòngyào, wǒ bú yuànyì wèi gōngzuò líkāi jiārén. (To me, life is also important; I don't want to leave my family for work.)
2. Duì tā lái shuō, xuéxí Hànyǔ hěn yǒu yìsi. (For her, learning Chinese is very interesting.)
3. Duì háizi lái shuō, wán yě shì yì zhǒng xuéxí. (For children, playing is also a form of learning.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '对……来说' (Desde la perspectiva de / Para...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Identifica la persona o grupo objetivo específico desde cuya perspectiva se aplica un juicio, sentimiento o punto de vista ("en cuanto a...", "a...").

grammar.name: Alternative Complex Sentence '或者……，或者……' (Either... or...)
grammar.formula: 或者 + 选项₁，或者 + 选项₂ (，或者 + 选项₃)
grammar.notes: Presents multiple alternative possibilities in declarative colloquial speech from which one can be selected ('either... or...').
grammar.examples:
1. 或者明天去，或者后天去，我给你打电话。
2. 我们或者今天去电影院看电影，或者明天在家看电影。
3. 晚饭你自己选，或者吃中国菜，或者吃日本菜。
grammar.translations:
1. Huòzhě míngtiān qù, huòzhě hòutiān qù, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà. (Either go tomorrow or the day after; I'll call you.)
2. Wǒmen huòzhě jīntiān qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, huòzhě míngtiān zài jiā kàn diànyǐng. (We either go to the cinema today or watch a movie at home tomorrow.)
3. Wǎnfàn nǐ zìjǐ xuǎn, huòzhě chī Zhōngguó cài, huòzhě chī Rìběn cài. (Choose dinner yourself: either Chinese or Japanese food.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja alternativa '或者……，或者……' (O... o...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Presenta múltiples posibilidades alternativas en el habla coloquial declarativa entre las cuales se puede seleccionar una ('o... o...').

grammar.point: 趋向补语的引申用法(2) “起来”
grammar.name: Extended Use of Directional Complement (2) '起来' (Inception of Action/State)
grammar.formula:
动词 / 形容词 + 起来
(若带宾语: 动词 + 起 + 宾语 + 来)
grammar.notes: Signifies the start and continuation of an action or the onset of a new state. If the verb has an object, the object splits '起' and '来'.
grammar.examples:
1. 雨已经下起来了。
2. 最近天气热起来了。
3. 怎么突然刮起风来了？
grammar.translations:
1. Yǔ yǐjīng xià qǐlai le. (The rain has already started falling.)
2. Zuìjìn tiānqì rè qǐlai le. (Lately the weather has started getting hot.)
3. Zěnme tūrán guā qǐ fēng lái le? (How did it suddenly start blowing wind?)
grammar.spanishName: Uso ampliado del complemento direccional (2) '起来' (Inicio de acción/estado)
grammar.spanishNotes: Significa el inicio y la continuación de una acción o el inicio de un nuevo estado. Si el verbo tiene un objeto, el objeto se divide en '起' y '来'.

grammar.point: 范围副词“就” 的用法
grammar.name: Adverb of Scope '就' (Exclusivity / Small Quantity / Exception)
grammar.formula:
• 数量少: 就 + 数量短语 + 动词
• 例外情况: 就 + 名词/名词性成分
grammar.notes:
• Preceding a number phrase, indicates that the speaker considers the quantity small, brief, or minimal ('only / just').
• Preceding a noun, highlights a single exception ('only').
grammar.examples:
1. 北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
2. 他昨天就看了十分钟书。
3. 我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。
4. 你们点的菜都挺好吃的，就我点的这个菜不太好吃。
grammar.translations:
1. Běijīng chángcháng xiàxuě, dàn tīngshuō jīnnián jiù xià le yí cì. (Beijing often snows, but I heard this year it only snowed once.)
2. Tā zuótiān jiù kàn le shí fēnzhōng shū. (He only read for 10 minutes yesterday.)
3. Wǒ měitiān shūbāo lǐ dōu fàngzhe yǔsǎn, jiù jīntiān méi dài. (I keep an umbrella in my bag every day, except today I didn't bring it.)
4. Nǐmen diǎn de cài dōu tǐng hǎochī de, jiù wǒ diǎn de zhège cài bú tài hǎochī. (All the dishes you ordered are good, except the one I ordered isn't.)
grammar.spanishName: Adverbio de alcance '就' (Exclusividad / Pequeña cantidad / Excepción)
grammar.spanishNotes:
• Preceder una frase numérica, indica que el hablante considera la cantidad pequeña, breve o mínima ("sólo/justo").
• Precediendo a un sustantivo, resalta una única excepción ("sólo").

grammar.point: 趋向补语的引申用法(3) “下来”
grammar.name: Extended Use of Directional Complement (3) '下来' (Completion through Effort)
grammar.formula: 动词 + 下来
grammar.notes: Indicates the successful completion or endurance of an action that required substantial time, effort, or overcoming difficulty.
grammar.examples:
1. 这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。
2. 这半年练下来，他画画的水平提高了不少。
3. 5000米的长跑比赛，没想到我跑下来了。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhè yì nián duō zhù xiàlai, wǒ háishi gèng xǐhuan Běijīng de sìjì. (After living through this past year and more, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons.)
2. Zhè bàn nián liàn xiàlai, tā huàhuà de shuǐpíng tígāo le bù shǎo. (After practicing through these six months, his painting skill improved greatly.)
3. 5000 mǐ de chángpǎo bǐsài, méi xiǎngdào wǒ pǎo xiàlai le. (In the 5,000-meter race, I never expected I would manage to finish running it.)
grammar.spanishName: Uso ampliado del complemento direccional (3) '下来' (Finalización mediante esfuerzo)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica la finalización exitosa o la resistencia de una acción que requirió mucho tiempo, esfuerzo o superación de dificultades.

grammar.name: Hypothetical Complex Sentence '……的话，就……' (If... then...)
grammar.formula: 假设小句 + 的话，(主语) + 就 + 结果分句
grammar.notes: Placed at the end of a conditional clause in colloquial speech to state an assumption ('if'), followed by the consequent action.
grammar.examples:
1. 你们有时间的话，就来我家做客。
2. 你觉得满意的话，咱们就买。
3. 明天天气好的话，我就去爬山。
grammar.translations:
1. Nǐmen yǒu shíjiān dehuà, jiù lái wǒ jiā zuòkè. (If you have time, come visit my home.)
2. Nǐ juéde mǎnyì dehuà, zánmen jiù mǎi. (If you are satisfied, let's buy it.)
3. Míngtiān tiānqì hǎo dehuà, wǒ jiù qù páshān. (If the weather is nice tomorrow, I'll go hiking.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración hipotética compleja '……的话，就……' (Si... entonces...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Colocado al final de una cláusula condicional en el habla coloquial para expresar una suposición ("si"), seguida de la acción consiguiente.

grammar.point: “把”字句(4) 趋向或状态变化
grammar.name: '把' Sentence (4) (Directional / State Complements)
grammar.formula: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 趋向补语 / 状态补语 (得……)
grammar.notes: Describes an action causing a definite object to undergo a shift in direction (放进冰箱里) or reach a notable state (开得太大).
grammar.examples:
1. 你把声音开得太大了，我去关小一点儿。
2. 我把饮料和酒都放进冰箱里了。
3. 你把字写得太小了，我看不清楚。
grammar.translations:
1. Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le, wǒ qù guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr. (You turned the sound up too loud; I'll turn it down a bit.)
2. Wǒ bǎ yǐnliào hé jiǔ dōu fàng jìn bīngxiāng lǐ le. (I put all the drinks and wine into the fridge.)
3. Nǐ bǎ zì xiě de tài xiǎo le, wǒ kàn bu qīngchu. (You wrote the characters too small; I can't see them clearly.)
grammar.spanishName: '把' Oración (4) (Complementos direccionales / estatales)
grammar.spanishNotes: Describe una acción que hace que un objeto definido cambie de dirección (放进冰箱里) o alcance un estado notable (开得太大).

grammar.name: Coordinate Complex Sentence '一边……，一边……' (Simultaneous Actions)
grammar.formula:
一边 + 动作₁，一边 + 动作₂
(紧缩形式: 边 + 动作₁ + 边 + 动作₂)
grammar.notes: Expresses that two actions are carried out at the same time by the subject ('while', 'simultaneously').
grammar.examples:
1. 咱们一边吃蛋糕，一边聊天儿吧。
2. 我喜欢一边跑步，一边听音乐。
3. 你不应该边开车边打电话。
grammar.translations:
1. Zánmen yìbiān chī dàngāo, yìbiān liáotiānr ba. (Let's chat while eating cake.)
2. Wǒ xǐhuan yìbiān pǎobù, yìbiān tīng yīnyuè. (I like listening to music while running.)
3. Nǐ bù yīnggāi biān kāichē biān dǎ diànhuà. (You shouldn't talk on the phone while driving.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja coordinada '一边……，一边……' (Acciones simultáneas)
grammar.spanishNotes: Expresa que dos acciones son realizadas al mismo tiempo por el sujeto ('mientras', 'simultáneamente').

grammar.name: Passive Sentences (1) '被' Sentence
grammar.formula: 主语 + (副词/能愿动词) + 被 + (施事者) + 动词 + 其他成分
grammar.notes: Expresses the passive voice, emphasizing that the grammatical subject is affected or influenced by an action, often conveying adversity, loss, or helplessness.
grammar.examples:
1. 这本书被别人借走了。
2. 水果可能被弟弟吃了。
3. 我们俩经常被叫错名字。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhè běn shū bèi biérén jiè zǒu le. (This book was borrowed by someone else.)
2. Shuǐguǒ kěnéng bèi dìdi chī le. (The fruit was probably eaten by little brother.)
3. Wǒmen liǎ chángcháng bèi jiào cuò míngzi. (The two of us are often called by the wrong names.)
grammar.spanishName: Oraciones pasivas (1) Oración '被'
grammar.spanishNotes: Expresa la voz pasiva, enfatizando que el sujeto gramatical se ve afectado o influenciado por una acción, a menudo transmitiendo adversidad, pérdida o impotencia.

grammar.name: Successive Complex Sentence '先……，再/然后……' (Sequential Actions)
grammar.formula: 先 + 动作₁，再 / 然后 + 动作₂
grammar.notes: Specifies the precise chronological sequence of two or more actions ('first..., then...').
grammar.examples:
1. 我要先去图书馆借书，然后去游泳。
2. 你先去买门票，再来这里找我。
3. 你们先回房间休息一会儿，然后再出来吃晚饭。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ yào xiān qù túshūguǎn jiè shū, ránhòu qù yóuyǒng. (I need to first borrow books from the library, then go swimming.)
2. Nǐ xiān qù mǎi ménpiào, zài lái zhèlǐ zhǎo wǒ. (First buy the tickets, then come find me here.)
3. Nǐmen xiān huí fángjiān xiūxi yíhuìr, ránhòu zài chūlai chī wǎnfàn. (Rest in your room first, then come out for dinner.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja sucesiva '先……，再/然后……' (Acciones secuenciales)
grammar.spanishNotes: Especifica la secuencia cronológica precisa de dos o más acciones ("primero..., luego...").

grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '×什么(啊)' (Rhetorical Dismissal / Reassurance)
grammar.formula: 形容词 / 动词 + 什么(啊)
grammar.notes: Colloquial pattern used to dismiss or negate the listener's worry, hesitation, or complaint, offering reassurance or mild refutation.
grammar.examples:
1. 紧张什么啊，我们都喜欢听你唱歌，你要相信自己。
2. 胖什么啊，你看起来不胖也不瘦。
3. 急什么啊，马上就到了。
grammar.translations:
1. Jǐnzhāng shénme a, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan tīng nǐ chànggē, nǐ yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ. (What's there to be nervous about? We love your singing; believe in yourself.)
2. Pàng shénme a, nǐ kànqilai bú pàng yě bú shòu. (What do you mean fat? You look neither fat nor thin.)
3. Jí shénme a, mǎshàng jiù dào le. (What's the rush? We're arriving in a moment.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '×什么(啊)' (desestimación retórica/tranquilización)
grammar.spanishNotes: Patrón coloquial utilizado para descartar o negar la preocupación, vacilación o queja del oyente, ofreciendo tranquilidad o refutación leve.

grammar.name: Preposition '根据' (According to / On the basis of)
grammar.formula: 根据 + 依据/理由/标准，谓语短语
grammar.notes: Introduces the ground, standard, basis, or reference according to which an action or judgment is executed.
grammar.examples:
1. 这几年小区根据他们的需要，有了很多变化。
2. 根据要求，我们必须参加明天的会议。
3. 老师根据每个学生的兴趣，选择了不一样的书。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhè jǐ nián xiǎoqū gēnjù tāmen de xūyào, yǒu le hěn duō biànhuà. (In recent years the complex made many changes according to their needs.)
2. Gēnjù yāoqiú, wǒmen bìxū cānjiā míngtiān de huìyì. (According to the requirements, we must attend tomorrow's meeting.)
3. Lǎoshī gēnjù měi ge xuésheng de xìngqù, xuǎnzé le bù yíyàng de shū. (The teacher chose different books according to each student's interest.)
grammar.spanishName: Preposición '根据' (Según / Sobre la base de)
grammar.spanishNotes: Introduce el fundamento, norma, fundamento o referencia según el cual se ejecuta una acción o sentencia.

grammar.point: 数量重叠“数词+量词+数词+量词”
grammar.name: Reduplication of Numeral-Measure Phrases 'Num+Cl+Num+Cl' (Step-by-step)
grammar.formula: 一 + 量词 + 一 + 量词 + (地) + 动词 (如：一点儿一点儿、一天一天、一个一个)
grammar.notes: Reduplicated numeral-measure phrases act as adverbials to vividly describe the measured, sequential, or gradual manner of an action ('bit by bit', 'one by one').
grammar.examples:
1. 那太多了，我得一点儿一点儿给您讲。
2. 学生们的汉语水平一天一天地提高了。
3. 他们两个两个地走进去了。
grammar.translations:
1. Nà tài duō le, wǒ děi yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr gěi nín jiǎng. (There are so many; I need to tell you bit by bit.)
2. Xuéshengmen de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng yìtiān yìtiān de tígāo le. (The students' Chinese level improved day by day.)
3. Tāmen liǎng ge liǎng ge de zǒu jìnqu le. (They walked inside two by two.)
grammar.spanishName: Reduplicación de frases de medidas numéricas 'Num+Cl+Num+Cl' (paso a paso)
grammar.spanishNotes: Las frases duplicadas con medidas numéricas actúan como adverbios para describir vívidamente la forma medida, secuencial o gradual de una acción ("poco a poco", "uno a uno").

grammar.name: Set Phrase '在……看来' (In one's view / From the perspective of)
grammar.formula: 在 + 人/群体 + 看来，观点分句
grammar.notes: Explicitly articulates the viewpoint, standpoint, or subjective perception held by a specific person or collective group.
grammar.examples:
1. 在我们中国人看来，黄河像妈妈一样，养了我们几千年。
2. 在同事们看来，她工作非常认真。
3. 在我看来，每天读书是一种很好的习惯。
grammar.translations:
1. Zài wǒmen Zhōngguórén kànlái, Huáng Hé xiàng māmā yíyàng, yǎng le wǒmen jǐ qiān nián. (In the eyes of us Chinese, the Yellow River is like a mother that has nurtured us for thousands of years.)
2. Zài tóngshìmen kànlái, tā gōngzuò fēicháng rènzhēn. (In her colleagues' view, she works very conscientiously.)
3. Zài wǒ kànlái, měitiān dúshū shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de xíguàn. (In my view, reading every day is a very good habit.)
grammar.spanishName: Frase fija '在……看来' (Desde la perspectiva de uno/Desde la perspectiva de)
grammar.spanishNotes: Articula explícitamente el punto de vista, punto de vista o percepción subjetiva que tiene una persona o grupo colectivo específico.

grammar.name: Set Phrase '不一会儿' (In a short while / Soon)
grammar.formula: 不一会儿，分句 / 主语 + 不一会儿 + 就……
grammar.notes: Functions as a temporal adverbial indicating that a very brief span of time elapsed before an event took place ('before long', 'soon').
grammar.examples:
1. 难过的事情不一会儿就忘了。
2. 不一会儿，张校长就来了。
3. 两个小时看起来长，但是不一会儿就过去了。
grammar.translations:
1. Nánguò de shìqing bù yíhuìr jiù wàng le. (Sad matters were forgotten in no time.)
2. Bù yíhuìr, Zhāng xiàozhǎng jiù lái le. (Before long, Principal Zhang arrived.)
3. Liǎng ge xiǎoshí kànqilai cháng, dànshì bù yíhuìr jiù guòqu le. (Two hours looks long, but it passed in a flash.)
grammar.spanishName: Frase establecida '不一会儿' (En breve / Pronto)
grammar.spanishNotes: Funciona como un adverbial temporal que indica que transcurrió un lapso de tiempo muy breve antes de que ocurriera un evento ("antes de mucho", "pronto").

grammar.point: 并列复句“一会儿……，一会儿……”
grammar.name: Coordinate Complex Sentence '一会儿……，一会儿……' (Alternating Actions/States)
grammar.formula: 主语 + 一会儿 + 动作/状态₁，一会儿 + 动作/状态₂
grammar.notes: Indicates two distinct, rapidly alternating actions or opposing conditions taking place in a brief timeframe ('now... now...', 'one moment... the next...').
grammar.examples:
1. 它一会儿在你脚边睡觉，一会儿在你身上爬。
2. 他一会儿进来，一会儿出去，忙得很。
3. 最近天气变化很快，一会儿冷，一会儿热。
grammar.translations:
1. Tā yíhuìr zài nǐ jiǎobiān shuìjiào, yíhuìr zài nǐ shēnshang pá. (One moment it sleeps by your feet, the next it climbs on you.)
2. Tā yíhuìr jìnlái, yíhuìr chūqu, máng de hěn. (He is in and out one moment after another, busy as can be.)
3. Zuìjìn tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, yíhuìr lěng, yíhuìr rè. (Lately the weather changes rapidly, cold one moment and hot the next.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja coordinada '一会儿……，一会儿……' (acciones/estados alternos)
grammar.spanishNotes: Indica dos acciones distintas, que se alternan rápidamente o condiciones opuestas que tienen lugar en un breve período de tiempo ("ahora... ahora...", "un momento... el siguiente...").

grammar.name: Preposition '关于' (Concerning / Regarding / About)
grammar.formula: 关于 + 涉及的对象，分句 / 关于……的 + 名词
grammar.notes: Introduces the central subject matter, topic, or scope of concern to be addressed ('concerning', 'with regard to').
grammar.examples:
1. 关于这个问题，我得慢慢给你讲。
2. 关于他的要求，我们还要开会以后再决定。
3. 关于比赛的时间，我明天一定告诉大家。
grammar.translations:
1. Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ děi mànmàn gěi nǐ jiǎng. (Regarding this question, I need to explain it to you slowly.)
2. Guānyú tā de yāoqiú, wǒmen hái yào kāihuì yǐhòu zài juédìng. (Regarding his request, we will decide after the meeting.)
3. Guānyú bǐsài de shíjiān, wǒ míngtiān yídìng gàosu dàjiā. (Regarding the match time, I will definitely tell everyone tomorrow.)
grammar.spanishName: Preposición '关于' (Respecto a / Respecto a / Acerca de)
grammar.spanishNotes: Introduce el tema central, tema o ámbito de interés que se abordará ("concerniente", "con respecto a").

grammar.name: Set Phrase '一般来说' (Generally Speaking)
grammar.formula: 一般来说，分句
grammar.notes: Colloquial framing phrase positioned at the beginning of a statement to indicate that what follows holds true in the vast majority of cases ('in general').
grammar.examples:
1. 一般来说，熊猫每天要睡很多次觉。
2. 一般来说，这种树每年开一次花。
3. 一般来说，学习外语需要多练习。
grammar.translations:
1. Yìbānláishuō, xióngmāo měitiān yào shuì hěn duō cì jiào. (Generally speaking, pandas sleep multiple times a day.)
2. Yìbānláishuō, zhè zhǒng shù měinián kāi yí cì huā. (Generally speaking, this tree blooms once a year.)
3. Yìbānláishuō, xuéxí wàiyǔ xūyào duō liànxí. (Generally speaking, learning a foreign language requires plenty of practice.)
grammar.spanishName: Frase establecida '一般来说' (en términos generales)
grammar.spanishNotes: Frase marco coloquial colocada al comienzo de una declaración para indicar que lo que sigue es cierto en la gran mayoría de los casos ("en general").

grammar.point: 比较句(11) 数量/时间差
grammar.name: Comparative Sentences (11) (Quantity / Temporal Disparity with '比')
grammar.formula: A + 比 + B + 多 / 少 / 早 / 晚 + 动词 + 数量短语
grammar.notes: Specifies a precise quantified difference in amount or timing between two entities when performing an action.
grammar.examples:
1. 冬天比夏天早关门一个小时。
2. 哥哥比弟弟多吃了三个饺子。
3. 我比他晚到了十分钟。
grammar.translations:
1. Dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān zǎo guānmén yí ge xiǎoshí. (In winter it closes one hour earlier than in summer.)
2. Gēge bǐ dìdi duō chī le sān ge jiǎozi. (Older brother ate three more jiaozi than little brother.)
3. Wǒ bǐ tā wǎn dào le shí fēnzhōng. (I arrived ten minutes later than him.)
grammar.spanishName: Oraciones comparativas (11) (Cantidad / Disparidad temporal con '比')
grammar.spanishNotes: Especifica una diferencia cuantificada precisa en cantidad o tiempo entre dos entidades al realizar una acción.

grammar.name: Preposition '向' (Toward / To / From)
grammar.formula: 向 + 人/对象/方向 + 动词短语
grammar.notes: Denotes the physical direction of movement, the target of an action, or the exemplar from whom one learns.
grammar.examples:
1. 别再向前走了，李老师的办公室已经到了。
2. 以后我要多向认真的人学习。
3. 孩子一看见妈妈，就向她跑过去了。
grammar.translations:
1. Bié zài xiàng qián zǒu le, Lǐ lǎoshī de bàngōngshì yǐjīng dào le. (Don't walk forward anymore; Teacher Li's office is reached.)
2. Yǐhòu wǒ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí. (From now on I will learn more from conscientious people.)
3. Háizi yí kànjiàn māmā, jiù xiàng tā pǎo guòqu le. (As soon as the child saw mom, he ran toward her.)
grammar.spanishName: Preposición '向' (Hacia / Hacia / Desde)
grammar.spanishNotes: Denota la dirección física del movimiento, el objetivo de una acción o el modelo del que se aprende.

grammar.name: Rhetorical Question '不是……吗？' (Isn't it...? / Didn't you...?)
grammar.formula: 主语 + 不是……吗？
grammar.notes: Uses a negative question form to assert an affirmative fact with strong emotional emphasis, expressing reminder, confirmation, or mild perplexity.
grammar.examples:
1. 你不是喜欢玩电脑吗？你可以去看看跟电脑有关系的书。
2. 你不是说今天有事吗？为什么来了？
3. 考试不是下个月吗？你怎么今天就开始复习了？
grammar.translations:
1. Nǐ bú shì xǐhuan wán diànnǎo ma? Nǐ kěyǐ qù kànkan gēn diànnǎo yǒu guānxì de shū. (Don't you like computers? You can check books about computers.)
2. Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yǒu shì ma? Wèishénme lái le? (Didn't you say you were busy today? Why did you come?)
3. Kǎoshì bú shì xià ge yuè ma? Nǐ zěnme jīntiān jiù kāishǐ fùxí le? (Isn't the exam next month? How come you started reviewing today?)
grammar.spanishName: Pregunta retórica '不是……吗？' (¿No es así...? / ¿No lo hiciste...?)
grammar.spanishNotes: Utiliza una forma de pregunta negativa para afirmar un hecho afirmativo con fuerte énfasis emocional, expresando recordatorio, confirmación o leve perplejidad.

grammar.name: Progressive Complex Sentence '……，更……' (Even more / All the more)
grammar.formula: 分句₁，(主语) + 更 + 谓语分句₂
grammar.notes: Elevates the statement to a deeper, more advanced, or more intense degree in the second clause ('even more so', 'furthermore').
grammar.examples:
1. 我还没想好学什么，更没想好去哪个国家。
2. 想提高中文水平要多听多看，更要多说多练。
3. 来中国学习，我学会了中文，更了解了中国文化。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, gèng méi xiǎnghǎo qù nǎge guójiā. (I haven't decided what to study, let alone which country to go to.)
2. Xiǎng tígāo Zhōngwén shuǐpíng yào duō tīng duō kàn, gèng yào duō shuō duō liàn. (To improve Chinese you must listen and read a lot, and even more speak and practice.)
3. Lái Zhōngguó xuéxí, wǒ xuéhuì le Zhōngwén, gèng liǎojiě le Zhōngguó wénhuà. (Studying in China, I learned Chinese and understood Chinese culture even deeper.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja progresiva '……，更……' (Aún más / Más)
grammar.spanishNotes: Eleva la afirmación a un grado más profundo, más avanzado o más intenso en la segunda cláusula ("aún más", "además").

grammar.name: Conditional Complex Sentence '只有……，才……' (Only if / Sole Condition)
grammar.formula: 只有 + 唯一必要条件，(主语) + 才 + 结果
grammar.notes: Specifies that the clause after '只有' is the indispensable, exclusive condition required for the outcome following '才' to occur.
grammar.examples:
1. 只有想清楚自己真正喜欢什么，才能做出最合适的选择。
2. 只有每天锻炼身体，才会越来越健康。
3. 只有多听、多说、多看，你的中文水平才能提高。
grammar.translations:
1. Zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme, cái néng zuòchū zuì héshì de xuǎnzé. (Only by figuring out what you truly like can you make the most suitable choice.)
2. Zhǐyǒu měitiān duànliàn shēntǐ, cái huì yuèláiyuè jiànkāng. (Only if you exercise daily will you get increasingly healthy.)
3. Zhǐyǒu duō tīng, duō shuō, duō kàn, nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng cái néng tígāo. (Only by listening, speaking, and reading more can your Chinese level improve.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja condicional '只有……，才……' (Sólo si / Condición única)
grammar.spanishNotes: Especifica que la cláusula después de '只有' es la condición exclusiva e indispensable necesaria para que se produzca el resultado después de '才'.

grammar.name: Approximate Numbers (Adjacent digits)
grammar.formula: 相邻两位数连用 (如：七八天、五六个、三四年前)
grammar.notes: Juxtaposing two consecutive numerals without punctuation indicates an estimation or rough approximate quantity.
grammar.examples:
1. 春节大概放七八天假。
2. 教室里来了五六个学生。
3. 这些照片是三四年前照的吧？
grammar.translations:
1. Chūnjié dàgài fàng qī-bā tiān jià. (The Spring Festival probably has about 7 or 8 days off.)
2. Jiàoshì lǐ lái le wǔ-liù ge xuésheng. (Five or six students came into the classroom.)
3. Zhèxiē zhàopiàn shì sān-sì nián qián zhào de ba? (Were these photos taken three or four years ago?)
grammar.spanishName: Números aproximados (dígitos adyacentes)
grammar.spanishNotes: La yuxtaposición de dos números consecutivos sin puntuación indica una estimación o una cantidad aproximada.

grammar.name: Comparison of '刚才' and '刚刚' (Just now: Time Noun vs. Time Adverb)
grammar.formula:
• 刚才 (时间名词): 可置于句首或主语后，指几分钟前的客观过去。
• 刚刚 (时间副词): 置于主语后、动词前，表示说话人感觉时间不长（几分钟至数月）。
grammar.notes:
• '刚才' is an objective time noun referring to moments ago.
• '刚刚' is an adverb reflecting the speaker's subjective perception that an event happened recently.
grammar.examples:
1. 刚才的电话是我妈妈打来的。
2. 我刚才看过一遍，不想再看了。
3. 我刚刚看视频学会了包饺子。
4. 他刚刚来北京两个月。
grammar.translations:
1. Gāngcái de diànhuà shì wǒ māmā dǎlai de. (The phone call just now was from my mom.)
2. Wǒ gāngcái kànguo yí biàn, bù xiǎng zài kàn le. (I just looked through it once a moment ago; I don't want to look again.)
3. Wǒ gānggāng kàn shìpín xuéhuì le bāo jiǎozi. (I just learned how to make dumplings by watching videos.)
4. Tā gānggāng lái Běijīng liǎng ge yuè. (He has only just been in Beijing for two months.)
grammar.spanishName: Comparación de '刚才' y '刚刚' (Justo ahora: sustantivo de tiempo versus adverbio de tiempo)
grammar.spanishNotes:
• '刚才' es un sustantivo de tiempo objetivo que se refiere a momentos atrás.
• '刚刚' es un adverbio que refleja la percepción subjetiva del hablante de que un evento ocurrió recientemente.

grammar.name: Conditional Complex Sentence '只要……，就……' (As long as / Sufficient Condition)
grammar.formula: 只要 + 充分条件，(主语) + 就 + 结果
grammar.notes: Introduces a sufficient condition that guarantees the specified outcome ('as long as..., then...'). If two subjects, the second precedes '就'.
grammar.examples:
1. 我只要几天不跟他视频，就很想他。
2. 只要你同意，我们就这么决定了。
3. 只要你坚持每天早睡，身体就一定会好起来。
grammar.translations:
1. Wǒ zhǐyào jǐ tiān bù gēn tā shìpín, jiù hěn xiǎng tā. (As long as I don't video chat with him for a few days, I miss him terribly.)
2. Zhǐyào nǐ tóngyì, wǒmen jiù zhème juédìng le. (As long as you agree, we'll decide on this.)
3. Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān zǎoshuì, shēntǐ jiù yídìng huì hǎo qǐlai. (As long as you stick to going to bed early daily, your health will surely improve.)
grammar.spanishName: Oración compleja condicional '只要……，就……' (Siempre y cuando / Condición suficiente)
grammar.spanishNotes: Introduce una condición suficiente que garantiza el resultado especificado ('siempre que..., entonces...'). Si hay dos sujetos, el segundo precede a '就'.

grammar.name: Fixed Pattern '从……起' (Starting from... / Since...)
grammar.formula: 从 + 时间点/事件 + 起，……
grammar.notes: Equivalent to '从...开始', placed at the beginning of a sentence to denote the starting temporal anchor of an ongoing action or state.
grammar.examples:
1. 他从那时起就努力学习。
2. 从那天起，我们就变成了好朋友。
3. 从那次旅游起，我对中国文化更有兴趣了。
grammar.translations:
1. Tā cóng nà shí qǐ jiù nǔlì xuéxí. (He studied hard from that time onward.)
2. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒmen jiù biànchéng le hǎo péngyou. (From that day forward, we became good friends.)
3. Cóng nà cì lǚyóu qǐ, wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gèng yǒu xìngqù le. (Ever since that trip, I became even more interested in Chinese culture.)
grammar.spanishName: Patrón fijo '从……起' (A partir de... / Desde...)
grammar.spanishNotes: Equivalente a '从...开始', colocado al principio de una oración para denotar el ancla temporal inicial de una acción o estado en curso.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他们看上去有点儿像。
grammarPhrases.english: Tāmen kànshangqu yǒudiǎnr xiàng. (They look a bit alike.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定短语“看上去 / 看起来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tāmen kànshangqu yǒudiǎnr xiàng.
grammarPhrases.translation: They look a bit alike.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Se parecen un poco.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这些菜看起来都很好吃。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhèxiē cài kànqilai dōu hěn hǎochī. (These dishes look very delicious.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定短语“看上去 / 看起来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài kànqilai dōu hěn hǎochī.
grammarPhrases.translation: These dishes look very delicious.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Estos platos se ven muy deliciosos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 那个新来的老师看上去很年轻。
grammarPhrases.english: Nàge xīn lái de lǎoshī kànshangqu hěn niánqīng. (That new teacher looks very young.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定短语“看上去 / 看起来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nàge xīn lái de lǎoshī kànshangqu hěn niánqīng.
grammarPhrases.translation: That new teacher looks very young.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Esa nueva maestra parece muy joven.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我好像在哪儿看到过这个箱子。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr kàndao guo zhège xiāngzi. (It seems I have seen this suitcase somewhere.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (1)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr kàndao guo zhège xiāngzi.
grammarPhrases.translation: It seems I have seen this suitcase somewhere.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Parece que he visto esta maleta en alguna parte.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你吃点儿什么再走吧。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ chī diǎnr shénme zài zǒu ba. (Eat something before you go.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (1)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ chī diǎnr shénme zài zǒu ba.
grammarPhrases.translation: Eat something before you go.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Come algo antes de irte.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我们哪天一起去踢足球吧。
