grammarPhrases.english: Wǒmen nǎ tiān yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú ba. (Let's play soccer together some day.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (1)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒmen nǎ tiān yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú ba.
grammarPhrases.translation: Let's play soccer together some day.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Juguemos al fútbol juntos algún día.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 李文是那个穿着黑衣服的短头发的年轻人吗？
grammarPhrases.english: Lǐ Wén shì nàge chuānzhe hēi yīfu de duǎn tóufa de niánqīngrén ma? (Is Li Wen that short-haired young man in black?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Lǐ Wén shì nàge chuānzhe hēi yīfu de duǎn tóufa de niánqīngrén ma?
grammarPhrases.translation: Is Li Wen that short-haired young man in black?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Es Li Wen ese joven de pelo corto vestido de negro?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 昨天和家月一起看电影的两个人是我的朋友。
grammarPhrases.english: Zuótiān hé Jiāyuè yìqǐ kàn diànyǐng de liǎng ge rén shì wǒ de péngyou. (The two people who watched the movie with Jiayue yesterday are my friends.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zuótiān hé Jiāyuè yìqǐ kàn diànyǐng de liǎng ge rén shì wǒ de péngyou.
grammarPhrases.translation: The two people who watched the movie with Jiayue yesterday are my friends.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Las dos personas que ayer vieron la película con Jiayue son mis amigos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我那件新买的白色的衣服在哪儿？
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ nà jiàn xīn mǎi de báisè de yīfu zài nǎr? (Where is my newly bought white clothing?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ nà jiàn xīn mǎi de báisè de yīfu zài nǎr?
grammarPhrases.translation: Where is my newly bought white clothing?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Dónde está mi ropa blanca recién comprada?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我现在还真是又饿又渴。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ xiànzài hái zhēnshi yòu è yòu kě. (Right now I'm truly both hungry and thirsty.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài hái zhēnshi yòu è yòu kě.
grammarPhrases.translation: Right now I'm truly both hungry and thirsty.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En este momento tengo realmente hambre y sed.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 那个女孩儿又高又漂亮。
grammarPhrases.english: Nàge nǚháir yòu gāo yòu piàoliang. (That girl is both tall and pretty.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nàge nǚháir yòu gāo yòu piàoliang.
grammarPhrases.translation: That girl is both tall and pretty.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Esa chica es alta y bonita.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这个饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhège fànguǎn de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī. (The dishes here are both cheap and delicious.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhège fànguǎn de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
grammarPhrases.translation: The dishes here are both cheap and delicious.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Los platos aquí son baratos y deliciosos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 哪个菜都好吃。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǎge cài dōu hǎochī. (Every dish is delicious / Any dish is good.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (2)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǎge cài dōu hǎochī.
grammarPhrases.translation: Every dish is delicious / Any dish is good.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cada plato es delicioso / Cualquier plato es bueno.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这次旅游，我去哪儿都可以。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè cì lǚyóu, wǒ qù nǎr dōu kěyǐ. (For this trip, I can go anywhere.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (2)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚyóu, wǒ qù nǎr dōu kěyǐ.
grammarPhrases.translation: For this trip, I can go anywhere.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Para este viaje, puedo ir a cualquier parte.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我下午有时间，你想什么时候来都没问题。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu shíjiān, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou lái dōu méi wèntí. (Coming whenever you want is completely fine.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (2)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu shíjiān, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou lái dōu méi wèntí.
grammarPhrases.translation: Coming whenever you want is completely fine.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Venir cuando quieras está completamente bien.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你们想吃什么就点什么。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme. (Order whatever you feel like eating.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (3)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme.
grammarPhrases.translation: Order whatever you feel like eating.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Pide lo que te apetezca comer.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你觉得哪个好看就买哪个。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ juéde nǎge hǎokàn jiù mǎi nǎge. (Buy whichever one you think looks nice.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (3)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎge hǎokàn jiù mǎi nǎge.
grammarPhrases.translation: Buy whichever one you think looks nice.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Compra el que creas que se ve bien.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你想去哪儿，我们就去哪儿。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr, wǒmen jiù qù nǎr. (Wherever you want to go, we will go there.)
grammarPhrases.source: 疑问代词的非疑问用法 (3)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr, wǒmen jiù qù nǎr.
grammarPhrases.translation: Wherever you want to go, we will go there.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Donde quieras ir, allí iremos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这个小区环境挺好的。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhège xiǎoqū huánjìng tǐng hǎo de. (The surroundings of this complex are quite nice.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū huánjìng tǐng hǎo de.
grammarPhrases.translation: The surroundings of this complex are quite nice.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Los alrededores de este complejo son bastante bonitos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这家饭馆的菜挺好吃的。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài tǐng hǎochī de. (The dishes at this restaurant are pretty tasty.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài tǐng hǎochī de.
grammarPhrases.translation: The dishes at this restaurant are pretty tasty.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Los platos de este restaurante son bastante sabrosos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 买这个吧，我挺喜欢这个颜色的。
grammarPhrases.english: Mǎi zhège ba, wǒ tǐng xǐhuan zhège yánsè de. (Let's buy this; I quite like this color.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Mǎi zhège ba, wǒ tǐng xǐhuan zhège yánsè de.
grammarPhrases.translation: Let's buy this; I quite like this color.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Compremos esto; Me gusta bastante este color.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我这几天忙坏了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān máng huài le. (I've been swamped / busy to death these past few days.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān máng huài le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I've been swamped / busy to death these past few days.
grammarPhrases.spanish: He estado abrumado/ocupado hasta la muerte estos últimos días.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我渴坏了，哪里能买水？
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ kě huài le, nǎlǐ néng mǎi shuǐ? (I'm terribly thirsty; where can I buy water?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ kě huài le, nǎlǐ néng mǎi shuǐ?
grammarPhrases.translation: I'm terribly thirsty; where can I buy water?
grammarPhrases.spanish: Tengo mucha sed; ¿Dónde puedo comprar agua?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这几天非常忙，大家都累坏了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè jǐ tiān fēicháng máng, dàjiā dōu lèi huài le. (Everyone is exhausted from being so busy.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān fēicháng máng, dàjiā dōu lèi huài le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Everyone is exhausted from being so busy.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Todos están agotados de estar tan ocupados.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 中国银行很近，走路几分钟就能到。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhōngguó Yínháng hěn jìn, zǒulù jǐ fēnzhōng jiù néng dào. (The bank is close; you can get there in just a few minutes.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhōngguó Yínháng hěn jìn, zǒulù jǐ fēnzhōng jiù néng dào.
grammarPhrases.translation: The bank is close; you can get there in just a few minutes.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El banco está cerca; Puedes llegar allí en solo unos minutos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我下午要去医院，很晚才能回来。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù yīyuàn, hěn wǎn cái néng huílái. (I have to go to hospital and won't return until late.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù yīyuàn, hěn wǎn cái néng huílái.
grammarPhrases.translation: I have to go to hospital and won't return until late.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Tengo que ir al hospital y no volveré hasta tarde.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我早上五点就起床了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le. (I got up as early as 5:00 a.m.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I got up as early as 5:00 a.m.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Me levanté tan temprano como a las 5:00 a.m.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 坐火车去北京，五个小时才能到。
grammarPhrases.english: Zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng, wǔ ge xiǎoshí cái néng dào. (By train to Beijing, it takes five hours to arrive.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng, wǔ ge xiǎoshí cái néng dào.
grammarPhrases.translation: By train to Beijing, it takes five hours to arrive.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En tren a Beijing se tarda cinco horas en llegar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 她一件衣服都不想买。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā yí jiàn yīfu dōu bù xiǎng mǎi. (She doesn't want to buy even a single piece of clothing.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā yí jiàn yīfu dōu bù xiǎng mǎi.
grammarPhrases.translation: She doesn't want to buy even a single piece of clothing.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No quiere comprar ni una sola prenda de vestir.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我一个中国电影也没看过。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ yí ge Zhōngguó diànyǐng yě méi kànguo. (I haven't watched even one Chinese movie.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge Zhōngguó diànyǐng yě méi kànguo.
grammarPhrases.translation: I haven't watched even one Chinese movie.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No he visto ni una sola película china.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 草原一点儿也不冷。
grammarPhrases.english: Cǎoyuán yìdiǎnr yě bù lěng. (The grasslands aren't cold at all.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Cǎoyuán yìdiǎnr yě bù lěng.
grammarPhrases.translation: The grasslands aren't cold at all.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Los pastizales no son nada fríos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他们一点儿也没着急。
grammarPhrases.english: Tāmen yìdiǎnr yě méi zháojí. (They weren't anxious in the least.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tāmen yìdiǎnr yě méi zháojí.
grammarPhrases.translation: They weren't anxious in the least.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No estaban ansiosos en lo más mínimo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè jiā bīnguǎn gēn biéde dōu bù yíyàng. (This hotel is unlike any other.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè jiā bīnguǎn gēn biéde dōu bù yíyàng.
grammarPhrases.translation: This hotel is unlike any other.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Este hotel no se parece a ningún otro.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他买的新手机跟我的一样。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā mǎi de xīn shǒujī gēn wǒ de yíyàng. (The new phone he bought is the same as mine.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā mǎi de xīn shǒujī gēn wǒ de yíyàng.
grammarPhrases.translation: The new phone he bought is the same as mine.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El nuevo teléfono que compró es igual al mío.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这个房间跟那个房间一样大。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhège fángjiān gēn nàge fángjiān yíyàng dà. (This room is just as large as that one.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān gēn nàge fángjiān yíyàng dà.
grammarPhrases.translation: This room is just as large as that one.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Esta habitación es tan grande como aquella.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 除了我以外，大家都在玩手机。
grammarPhrases.english: Chúle wǒ yǐwài, dàjiā dōu zài wán shǒujī. (Except for me, everyone is on their phones.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定格式“除了……(以外)，……都/还/也……”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Chúle wǒ yǐwài, dàjiā dōu zài wán shǒujī.
grammarPhrases.translation: Except for me, everyone is on their phones.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Excepto yo, todos están en sus teléfonos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 除了这个汉字，别的汉字我都会写。
grammarPhrases.english: Chúle zhège hànzì, biéde hànzì wǒ dōu huì xiě. (Except this character, I can write all the others.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定格式“除了……(以外)，……都/还/也……”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Chúle zhège hànzì, biéde hànzì wǒ dōu huì xiě.
grammarPhrases.translation: Except this character, I can write all the others.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Excepto este personaje, puedo escribir todos los demás.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 除了这个行李箱以外，还有别的东西吗？
grammarPhrases.english: Chúle zhège xínglixiāng yǐwài, hái yǒu biéde dōngxi ma? (Besides this suitcase, is there anything else?)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定格式“除了……(以外)，……都/还/也……”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Chúle zhège xínglixiāng yǐwài, hái yǒu biéde dōngxi ma?
grammarPhrases.translation: Besides this suitcase, is there anything else?
grammarPhrases.spanish: Además de esta maleta, ¿hay algo más?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 除了唱歌以外，他也喜欢跳舞。
grammarPhrases.english: Chúle chànggē yǐwài, tā yě xǐhuan tiàowǔ. (Besides singing, he also likes dancing.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定格式“除了……(以外)，……都/还/也……”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Chúle chànggē yǐwài, tā yě xǐhuan tiàowǔ.
grammarPhrases.translation: Besides singing, he also likes dancing.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Además de cantar, también le gusta bailar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 现在天气好得很。
grammarPhrases.english: Xiànzài tiānqì hǎo de hěn. (The weather right now is wonderfully good.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Xiànzài tiānqì hǎo de hěn.
grammarPhrases.translation: The weather right now is wonderfully good.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El clima ahora mismo es maravillosamente bueno.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 房间里面热得很。
grammarPhrases.english: Fángjiān lǐmiàn rè de hěn. (It is terribly hot inside the room.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐmiàn rè de hěn.
grammarPhrases.translation: It is terribly hot inside the room.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Hace un calor terrible dentro de la habitación.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我觉得爬山累得很。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ juéde páshān lèi de hěn. (I think hiking is awfully exhausting.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ juéde páshān lèi de hěn.
grammarPhrases.translation: I think hiking is awfully exhausting.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Creo que el senderismo es tremendamente agotador.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这些照片张张都非常好看。(= 每张都好看)
grammarPhrases.english: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn zhāngzhāng dōu fēicháng hǎokàn. (Every single one of these photos is beautiful.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn zhāngzhāng dōu fēicháng hǎokàn.
grammarPhrases.translation: Every single one of these photos is beautiful.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cada una de estas fotos es hermosa.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这些苹果个个都很大。(= 每个都很大)
grammarPhrases.english: Zhèxiē píngguǒ gègè dōu hěn dà. (Every single one of these apples is big.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ gègè dōu hěn dà.
grammarPhrases.translation: Every single one of these apples is big.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cada una de estas manzanas es grande.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我想出去拍照，但是天天下雨。(= 每天都下雨)
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ xiǎng chūqu pāizhào, dànshì tiāntiān xiàyǔ. (I want to go take photos, but it rains every day.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūqu pāizhào, dànshì tiāntiān xiàyǔ.
grammarPhrases.translation: I want to go take photos, but it rains every day.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Quiero ir a tomar fotos, pero llueve todos los días.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 后边走过去两个人。
grammarPhrases.english: Hòubian zǒu guòqu liǎng ge rén. (Two people walked past from behind.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Hòubian zǒu guòqu liǎng ge rén.
grammarPhrases.translation: Two people walked past from behind.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Dos personas pasaron por detrás.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 前面开过来很多车。
grammarPhrases.english: Qiánmian kāi guòlai hěn duō chē. (Many cars drove over from the front.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Qiánmian kāi guòlai hěn duō chē.
grammarPhrases.translation: Many cars drove over from the front.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Muchos coches pasaron por delante.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 楼上下来了几个人。
grammarPhrases.english: Lóushang xiàlai le jǐ ge rén. (Several people came down from upstairs.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Lóushang xiàlai le jǐ ge rén.
grammarPhrases.translation: Several people came down from upstairs.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Varias personas bajaron del piso de arriba.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你听完了音乐会就来我家吃饭。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ tīngwán le yīnyuèhuì jiù lái wǒ jiā chīfàn. (Come to my house for dinner right after the concert finishes.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ tīngwán le yīnyuèhuì jiù lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
grammarPhrases.translation: Come to my house for dinner right after the concert finishes.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Ven a cenar a mi casa justo después de que termine el concierto.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我吃了早饭就去学校了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ chī le zǎofàn jiù qù xuéxiào le. (I went to school right after eating breakfast.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ chī le zǎofàn jiù qù xuéxiào le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I went to school right after eating breakfast.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Fui a la escuela justo después de desayunar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 昨天我们下了课就回家了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zuótiān wǒmen xià le kè jiù huíjiā le. (Yesterday we went home right after class ended.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen xià le kè jiù huíjiā le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Yesterday we went home right after class ended.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Ayer nos fuimos a casa justo después de terminar la clase.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 咱们该买去上海的票了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zánmen gāi mǎi qù Shànghǎi de piào le. (It's time for us to buy the tickets to Shanghai.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zánmen gāi mǎi qù Shànghǎi de piào le.
grammarPhrases.translation: It's time for us to buy the tickets to Shanghai.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Es hora de que compremos los billetes a Shanghai.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 八点了，该上课了。
grammarPhrases.english: Bā diǎn le, gāi shàngkè le. (It's 8:00; time to start class.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Bā diǎn le, gāi shàngkè le.
grammarPhrases.translation: It's 8:00; time to start class.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Son las 8:00; hora de empezar la clase.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 已经很晚了，我该睡觉了。
grammarPhrases.english: Yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, wǒ gāi shuìjiào le. (It's already very late; I should go to sleep.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, wǒ gāi shuìjiào le.
grammarPhrases.translation: It's already very late; I should go to sleep.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Ya es muy tarde; Debería irme a dormir.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 如果没走错，二十分钟以前就到了。
grammarPhrases.english: Rúguǒ méi zǒucuò, èrshí fēnzhōng yǐqián jiù dào le. (If we hadn't taken the wrong turn, we would have arrived 20 minutes ago.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Rúguǒ méi zǒucuò, èrshí fēnzhōng yǐqián jiù dào le.
grammarPhrases.translation: If we hadn't taken the wrong turn, we would have arrived 20 minutes ago.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Si no nos hubiéramos equivocado de dirección, habríamos llegado hace 20 minutos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 如果你需要帮忙，就给我打电话。
grammarPhrases.english: Rúguǒ nǐ xūyào bāngmáng, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà. (If you need help, just call me.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xūyào bāngmáng, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
grammarPhrases.translation: If you need help, just call me.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Si necesitas ayuda, sólo llámame.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 如果有时间，我就去上海玩几天。
grammarPhrases.english: Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù Shànghǎi wán jǐ tiān. (If I have time, I will go spend a few days in Shanghai.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù Shànghǎi wán jǐ tiān.
grammarPhrases.translation: If I have time, I will go spend a few days in Shanghai.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Si tengo tiempo, pasaré unos días en Shanghai.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 前面的人越来越多。
grammarPhrases.english: Qiánmian de rén yuèláiyuè duō. (There are more and more people ahead.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Qiánmian de rén yuèláiyuè duō.
grammarPhrases.translation: There are more and more people ahead.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cada vez hay más gente por delante.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我越来越喜欢这里的生活了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ yuèláiyuè xǐhuan zhèlǐ de shēnghuó le. (I like living here more and more.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ yuèláiyuè xǐhuan zhèlǐ de shēnghuó le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I like living here more and more.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cada vez me gusta más vivir aquí.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 她越来越高，也越来越漂亮了。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā yuèláiyuè gāo, yě yuèláiyuè piàoliang le. (She is getting taller and prettier.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā yuèláiyuè gāo, yě yuèláiyuè piàoliang le.
grammarPhrases.translation: She is getting taller and prettier.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Ella es cada vez más alta y bonita.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 咱们可以走着去。
grammarPhrases.english: Zánmen kěyǐ zǒuzhe qù. (We can go there on foot / walking.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zánmen kěyǐ zǒuzhe qù.
grammarPhrases.translation: We can go there on foot / walking.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Podemos ir a pie/caminando.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 弟弟吃着苹果写作业。
grammarPhrases.english: Dìdi chīzhe píngguǒ xiě zuòyè. (Little brother is doing homework while eating an apple.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Dìdi chīzhe píngguǒ xiě zuòyè.
grammarPhrases.translation: Little brother is doing homework while eating an apple.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El hermano pequeño está haciendo los deberes mientras come una manzana.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他们坐着看电视。
grammarPhrases.english: Tāmen zuòzhe kàn diànshì. (They are sitting watching television.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tāmen zuòzhe kàn diànshì.
grammarPhrases.translation: They are sitting watching television.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Están sentados viendo la televisión.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 裙子不比短裤贵多少。
grammarPhrases.english: Qúnzi bù bǐ duǎnkù guì duōshao. (The skirt isn't much more expensive than the shorts.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Qúnzi bù bǐ duǎnkù guì duōshao.
grammarPhrases.translation: The skirt isn't much more expensive than the shorts.
grammarPhrases.spanish: La falda no es mucho más cara que los pantalones cortos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他的中文不比你好。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā de Zhōngwén bù bǐ nǐ hǎo. (His Chinese is not better than yours.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén bù bǐ nǐ hǎo.
grammarPhrases.translation: His Chinese is not better than yours.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Su chino no es mejor que el tuyo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他跑得不比我快多少。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā pǎo de bù bǐ wǒ kuài duōshao. (He doesn't run much faster than me.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā pǎo de bù bǐ wǒ kuài duōshao.
grammarPhrases.translation: He doesn't run much faster than me.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No corre mucho más rápido que yo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这块冰西瓜甜极了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè kuài bīng xīguā tián jí le. (This chilled watermelon is extremely sweet.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè kuài bīng xīguā tián jí le.
grammarPhrases.translation: This chilled watermelon is extremely sweet.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Esta sandía fría es extremadamente dulce.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 今年夏天热极了。
grammarPhrases.english: Jīnnián xiàtiān rè jí le. (This summer is extremely hot.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Jīnnián xiàtiān rè jí le.
grammarPhrases.translation: This summer is extremely hot.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Este verano es extremadamente caluroso.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这本书我喜欢极了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè běn shū wǒ xǐhuan jí le. (I like this book to bits / very much.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ xǐhuan jí le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I like this book to bits / very much.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Me gusta mucho este libro.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 现在的电视不但便宜，而且用着非常方便。
grammarPhrases.english: Xiànzài de diànshì búdàn piányi, érqiě yòngzhe fēicháng fāngbiàn. (Modern TVs are not only cheap, but also very convenient to use.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànshì búdàn piányi, érqiě yòngzhe fēicháng fāngbiàn.
grammarPhrases.translation: Modern TVs are not only cheap, but also very convenient to use.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Los televisores modernos no sólo son baratos, sino también muy cómodos de usar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 家月不但喜欢唱歌，而且唱得很好听。
grammarPhrases.english: Jiāyuè búdàn xǐhuan chànggē, érqiě chàng de hěn hǎotīng. (Jiayue not only likes singing, but sings very nicely.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Jiāyuè búdàn xǐhuan chànggē, érqiě chàng de hěn hǎotīng.
grammarPhrases.translation: Jiayue not only likes singing, but sings very nicely.
grammarPhrases.spanish: A Jiayue no solo le gusta cantar, sino que canta muy bien.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 不但家月会说汉语，而且天中也会说汉语。
grammarPhrases.english: Búdàn Jiāyuè huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě Tiānzhōng yě huì shuō Hànyǔ. (Not only Jiayue can speak Chinese, but Tianzhong can too.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Búdàn Jiāyuè huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě Tiānzhōng yě huì shuō Hànyǔ.
grammarPhrases.translation: Not only Jiayue can speak Chinese, but Tianzhong can too.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No sólo Jiayue puede hablar chino, sino que Tianzhong también puede hacerlo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我今年胖了十多斤，不能再胖下去了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ jīnnián pàng le shí duō jīn, bù néng zài pàng xiàqu le. (I gained over 10 jin this year; I can't keep getting fatter.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(1) “下去”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián pàng le shí duō jīn, bù néng zài pàng xiàqu le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I gained over 10 jin this year; I can't keep getting fatter.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Gané más de 10 jin este año; No puedo seguir engordando.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 她读完了第一个问题，后面的你读下去。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā dúwán le dì-yī ge wèntí, hòumian de nǐ dú xiàqu. (She read the first question; you continue reading the rest.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(1) “下去”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā dúwán le dì-yī ge wèntí, hòumian de nǐ dú xiàqu.
grammarPhrases.translation: She read the first question; you continue reading the rest.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Leyó la primera pregunta; continúas leyendo el resto.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这几天太热了，如果再热下去就不能出门了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè jǐ tiān tài rè le, rúguǒ zài rè xiàqu jiù bù néng chūmén le. (If it keeps getting hotter, we won't be able to go out.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(1) “下去”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tài rè le, rúguǒ zài rè xiàqu jiù bù néng chūmén le.
grammarPhrases.translation: If it keeps getting hotter, we won't be able to go out.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Si sigue haciendo más calor, no podremos salir.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 昨天游完泳以后，我的耳朵一直有点儿疼。
grammarPhrases.english: Zuótiān yóuwán yǒng yǐhòu, wǒ de ěrduo yìzhí yǒudiǎnr téng. (After finishing swimming yesterday, my ear kept hurting.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zuótiān yóuwán yǒng yǐhòu, wǒ de ěrduo yìzhí yǒudiǎnr téng.
grammarPhrases.translation: After finishing swimming yesterday, my ear kept hurting.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Después de terminar de nadar ayer, me seguía doliendo el oído.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我先回去睡一觉，可能休息休息就好了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ xiān huíqu shuì yí jiào, kěnéng xiūxi xiūxi jiù hǎo le. (I'll go home and take a nap first; maybe I'll feel better.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ xiān huíqu shuì yí jiào, kěnéng xiūxi xiūxi jiù hǎo le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I'll go home and take a nap first; maybe I'll feel better.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Primero iré a casa y tomaré una siesta; tal vez me sienta mejor.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 今年夏天只下了两次雨。
grammarPhrases.english: Jīnnián xiàtiān zhǐ xià le liǎng cì yǔ. (It only rained twice this summer.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Jīnnián xiàtiān zhǐ xià le liǎng cì yǔ.
grammarPhrases.translation: It only rained twice this summer.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Este verano sólo llovió dos veces.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我上次来医院已经过去差不多两年了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ shàng cì lái yīyuàn yǐjīng guòqu chàbuduō liǎng nián le. (It has been nearly two years since I last came to the hospital.)
grammarPhrases.source: 时量补语(2) 非延续性动词
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì lái yīyuàn yǐjīng guòqu chàbuduō liǎng nián le.
grammarPhrases.translation: It has been nearly two years since I last came to the hospital.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Han pasado casi dos años desde la última vez que vine al hospital.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 她回家两个月了。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā huíjiā liǎng ge yuè le. (It has been two months since she returned home.)
grammarPhrases.source: 时量补语(2) 非延续性动词
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā huíjiā liǎng ge yuè le.
grammarPhrases.translation: It has been two months since she returned home.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Han pasado dos meses desde que regresó a casa.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 开学已经三个多星期了。
grammarPhrases.english: Kāixué yǐjīng sān ge duō xīngqī le. (School has been in session for over three weeks already.)
grammarPhrases.source: 时量补语(2) 非延续性动词
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Kāixué yǐjīng sān ge duō xīngqī le.
grammarPhrases.translation: School has been in session for over three weeks already.
grammarPhrases.spanish: La escuela ya lleva más de tres semanas en sesión.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这种药需要每天睡前吃一次。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè zhǒng yào xūyào měitiān shuìqián chī yí cì. (This medicine needs to be taken once before bed daily.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定格式“……以前/以后/前/后”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào xūyào měitiān shuìqián chī yí cì.
grammarPhrases.translation: This medicine needs to be taken once before bed daily.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Este medicamento debe tomarse una vez al día antes de acostarse.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我们决定下班后一起去看个电影。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒmen juédìng xiàbānhòu yìqǐ qù kàn ge diànyǐng. (We decided to go watch a movie together after work.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定格式“……以前/以后/前/后”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒmen juédìng xiàbānhòu yìqǐ qù kàn ge diànyǐng.
grammarPhrases.translation: We decided to go watch a movie together after work.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Decidimos ir a ver una película juntos después del trabajo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 考完试以后，咱们一起去旅游吧。
grammarPhrases.english: Kǎowán shì yǐhòu, zánmen yìqǐ qù lǚyóu ba. (Let's travel together after finishing the exams.)
grammarPhrases.source: 固定格式“……以前/以后/前/后”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Kǎowán shì yǐhòu, zánmen yìqǐ qù lǚyóu ba.
grammarPhrases.translation: Let's travel together after finishing the exams.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Viajemos juntos después de terminar los exámenes.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 听说为了准备运动会，你们几个男生每天都练球。
grammarPhrases.english: Tīngshuō wèile zhǔnbèi yùndònghuì, nǐmen jǐ ge nánshēng měitiān dōu liàn qiú. (I heard that to prepare for the sports meet, you boys practice ball daily.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tīngshuō wèile zhǔnbèi yùndònghuì, nǐmen jǐ ge nánshēng měitiān dōu liàn qiú.
grammarPhrases.translation: I heard that to prepare for the sports meet, you boys practice ball daily.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Escuché que para prepararse para la competencia deportiva, ustedes practican pelota todos los días.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 为了考上大学，她每天努力学习。
grammarPhrases.english: Wèile kǎoshàng dàxué, tā měitiān nǔlì xuéxí. (In order to get into college, she studies hard every day.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wèile kǎoshàng dàxué, tā měitiān nǔlì xuéxí.
grammarPhrases.translation: In order to get into college, she studies hard every day.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Para poder ingresar a la universidad, estudia mucho todos los días.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 为了早点儿到家，我打算坐飞机回去。
grammarPhrases.english: Wèile zǎodiǎnr dào jiā, wǒ dǎsuàn zuò fēijī huíqu. (To arrive home earlier, I plan to fly back.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wèile zǎodiǎnr dào jiā, wǒ dǎsuàn zuò fēijī huíqu.
grammarPhrases.translation: To arrive home earlier, I plan to fly back.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Para llegar antes a casa, planeo volar de regreso.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 不是比赛，打不好没关系。
grammarPhrases.english: Bú shì bǐsài, dǎ bu hǎo méi guānxi. (It's not a match; it doesn't matter if you can't play well.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Bú shì bǐsài, dǎ bu hǎo méi guānxi.
grammarPhrases.translation: It's not a match; it doesn't matter if you can't play well.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No es una coincidencia; No importa si no puedes jugar bien.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这本书你看得懂看不懂？
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bu dǒng? (Can you understand this book?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bu dǒng?
grammarPhrases.translation: Can you understand this book?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Puedes entender este libro?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你只有一个星期的时间，学得会游泳吗？
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ zhǐyǒu yí ge xīngqī de shíjiān, xué de huì yóuyǒng ma? (With only one week, can you manage to learn swimming?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐyǒu yí ge xīngqī de shíjiān, xué de huì yóuyǒng ma?
grammarPhrases.translation: With only one week, can you manage to learn swimming?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Con sólo una semana podrás aprender a nadar?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 今天的足球比赛我越看越着急。
grammarPhrases.english: Jīntiān de zúqiú bǐsài wǒ yuè kàn yuè zháojí. (The more I watched today's football match, the more anxious I felt.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Jīntiān de zúqiú bǐsài wǒ yuè kàn yuè zháojí.
grammarPhrases.translation: The more I watched today's football match, the more anxious I felt.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cuanto más veía el partido de fútbol de hoy, más ansioso me sentía.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 妈妈越说，他越不高兴。
grammarPhrases.english: Māmā yuè shuō, tā yuè bù gāoxìng. (The more mom talked, the unhappier he became.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Māmā yuè shuō, tā yuè bù gāoxìng.
grammarPhrases.translation: The more mom talked, the unhappier he became.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cuanto más hablaba mamá, más infeliz se volvía.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我想认识中国朋友，越多越好。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ xiǎng rènshi Zhōngguó péngyou, yuè duō yuè hǎo. (I want to make Chinese friends; the more the better.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng rènshi Zhōngguó péngyou, yuè duō yuè hǎo.
grammarPhrases.translation: I want to make Chinese friends; the more the better.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Quiero hacer amigos chinos; cuanto más mejor.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我会把这些题都记在本子上。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ huì bǎ zhèxiē tí dōu jì zài běnzi shang. (I will write all these questions down in my notebook.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ huì bǎ zhèxiē tí dōu jì zài běnzi shang.
grammarPhrases.translation: I will write all these questions down in my notebook.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Escribiré todas estas preguntas en mi cuaderno.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 老师把作业本放到桌子上了。
grammarPhrases.english: Lǎoshī bǎ zuòyèběn fàng dào zhuōzi shang le. (The teacher placed the exercise books onto the table.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zuòyèběn fàng dào zhuōzi shang le.
grammarPhrases.translation: The teacher placed the exercise books onto the table.
grammarPhrases.spanish: La profesora colocó los cuadernos sobre la mesa.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你不能把名字写在这里。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ bù néng bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhèlǐ. (You cannot write your name here.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhèlǐ.
grammarPhrases.translation: You cannot write your name here.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No puedes escribir tu nombre aquí.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 在学习上，遇到什么问题都可以问我。
grammarPhrases.english: Zài xuéxí shang, yùdào shénme wèntí dōu kěyǐ wèn wǒ. (In terms of studies, feel free to ask me any question.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zài xuéxí shang, yùdào shénme wèntí dōu kěyǐ wèn wǒ.
grammarPhrases.translation: In terms of studies, feel free to ask me any question.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En cuanto a estudios, no dudes en consultarme cualquier duda.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 在比赛中，他得分最高。
grammarPhrases.english: Zài bǐsài zhōng, tā défēn zuì gāo. (In the competition, he scored the highest points.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zài bǐsài zhōng, tā défēn zuì gāo.
grammarPhrases.translation: In the competition, he scored the highest points.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En la competición obtuvo los puntos más altos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 在老师的帮助下，我的成绩提高很快。
grammarPhrases.english: Zài lǎoshī de bāngzhù xià, wǒ de chéngjì tígāo hěn kuài. (Under the teacher's help, my grades improved rapidly.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zài lǎoshī de bāngzhù xià, wǒ de chéngjì tígāo hěn kuài.
grammarPhrases.translation: Under the teacher's help, my grades improved rapidly.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Con la ayuda del profesor, mis notas mejoraron rápidamente.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你明天再把书还给我。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ míngtiān zài bǎ shū huán gěi wǒ. (You can return the book to me tomorrow.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān zài bǎ shū huán gěi wǒ.
grammarPhrases.translation: You can return the book to me tomorrow.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Puedes devolverme el libro mañana.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我把礼物送给她了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ bǎ lǐwù sòng gěi tā le. (I gave the gift to her.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ lǐwù sòng gěi tā le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I gave the gift to her.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Le di el regalo a ella.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 请你把这本书带给老师。
grammarPhrases.english: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè běn shū dài gěi lǎoshī. (Please take this book to the teacher.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè běn shū dài gěi lǎoshī.
grammarPhrases.translation: Please take this book to the teacher.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Por favor lleve este libro al maestro.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我们用会议室的电脑还是自己的笔记本电脑？
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒmen yòng huìyìshì de diànnǎo háishi zìjǐ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo? (Shall we use the conference computer or our own laptops?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒmen yòng huìyìshì de diànnǎo háishi zìjǐ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo?
grammarPhrases.translation: Shall we use the conference computer or our own laptops?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Usamos el ordenador de la conferencia o nuestros propios portátiles?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 会议室的电脑或者自己的电脑都可以。
grammarPhrases.english: Huìyìshì de diànnǎo huòzhě zìjǐ de diànnǎo dōu kěyǐ. (Either the conference room's computer or your own is fine.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Huìyìshì de diànnǎo huòzhě zìjǐ de diànnǎo dōu kěyǐ.
grammarPhrases.translation: Either the conference room's computer or your own is fine.
grammarPhrases.spanish: O el ordenador de la sala de conferencias o el tuyo propio están bien.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你可以坐地铁或者打车去学校。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò dìtiě huòzhě dǎchē qù xuéxiào. (You can take the subway or take a taxi to school.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò dìtiě huòzhě dǎchē qù xuéxiào.
grammarPhrases.translation: You can take the subway or take a taxi to school.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Puedes tomar el metro o tomar un taxi hasta la escuela.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 看来我没办法解决这个问题。
grammarPhrases.english: Kànlái wǒ méi bànfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí. (It seems I have no way to solve this problem.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Kànlái wǒ méi bànfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí.
grammarPhrases.translation: It seems I have no way to solve this problem.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Parece que no tengo manera de resolver este problema.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这么晚了，看来他今天不会来了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhème wǎn le, kànlái tā jīntiān bú huì lái le. (It's so late; it looks like he won't be coming today.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, kànlái tā jīntiān bú huì lái le.
grammarPhrases.translation: It's so late; it looks like he won't be coming today.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Es muy tarde; Parece que no vendrá hoy.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 电梯坏了，看来咱们只能走下去了。
grammarPhrases.english: Diàntī huài le, kànlái zánmen zhǐ néng zǒu xiàqu le. (The elevator is broken; looks like we can only walk down.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Diàntī huài le, kànlái zánmen zhǐ néng zǒu xiàqu le.
grammarPhrases.translation: The elevator is broken; looks like we can only walk down.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El ascensor está averiado; Parece que sólo podemos caminar hacia abajo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我跟您一起把这些工作做完。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ gēn nín yìqǐ bǎ zhèxiē gōngzuò zuòwán. (I will finish this work together with you.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ gēn nín yìqǐ bǎ zhèxiē gōngzuò zuòwán.
grammarPhrases.translation: I will finish this work together with you.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Terminaré este trabajo junto contigo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 妈妈把衣服洗干净了。
grammarPhrases.english: Māmā bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng le. (Mom washed the clothes clean.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Māmā bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Mom washed the clothes clean.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Mamá lavó la ropa hasta dejarla limpia.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他还没把笔记本电脑接好呢。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā hái méi bǎ bǐjìběn diànnǎo jiēhǎo ne. (He hasn't finished connecting the laptop properly yet.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā hái méi bǎ bǐjìběn diànnǎo jiēhǎo ne.
grammarPhrases.translation: He hasn't finished connecting the laptop properly yet.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Aún no ha terminado de conectar correctamente la computadora portátil.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 对我来说，生活也很重要，我不愿意为工作离开家人。
grammarPhrases.english: Duì wǒ lái shuō, shēnghuó yě hěn zhòngyào, wǒ bú yuànyì wèi gōngzuò líkāi jiārén. (To me, life is also important; I don't want to leave my family for work.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, shēnghuó yě hěn zhòngyào, wǒ bú yuànyì wèi gōngzuò líkāi jiārén.
grammarPhrases.translation: To me, life is also important; I don't want to leave my family for work.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Para mí la vida también es importante; No quiero dejar a mi familia por trabajar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 对她来说，学习汉语很有意思。
grammarPhrases.english: Duì tā lái shuō, xuéxí Hànyǔ hěn yǒu yìsi. (For her, learning Chinese is very interesting.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, xuéxí Hànyǔ hěn yǒu yìsi.
grammarPhrases.translation: For her, learning Chinese is very interesting.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Para ella, aprender chino es muy interesante.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 对孩子来说，玩也是一种学习。
grammarPhrases.english: Duì háizi lái shuō, wán yě shì yì zhǒng xuéxí. (For children, playing is also a form of learning.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Duì háizi lái shuō, wán yě shì yì zhǒng xuéxí.
grammarPhrases.translation: For children, playing is also a form of learning.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Para los niños, jugar también es una forma de aprender.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 或者明天去，或者后天去，我给你打电话。
grammarPhrases.english: Huòzhě míngtiān qù, huòzhě hòutiān qù, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà. (Either go tomorrow or the day after; I'll call you.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Huòzhě míngtiān qù, huòzhě hòutiān qù, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
grammarPhrases.translation: Either go tomorrow or the day after; I'll call you.
grammarPhrases.spanish: O ve mañana o pasado; Te llamaré.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我们或者今天去电影院看电影，或者明天在家看电影。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒmen huòzhě jīntiān qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, huòzhě míngtiān zài jiā kàn diànyǐng. (We either go to the cinema today or watch a movie at home tomorrow.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒmen huòzhě jīntiān qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, huòzhě míngtiān zài jiā kàn diànyǐng.
grammarPhrases.translation: We either go to the cinema today or watch a movie at home tomorrow.
grammarPhrases.spanish: O vamos al cine hoy o mañana vemos una película en casa.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 晚饭你自己选，或者吃中国菜，或者吃日本菜。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǎnfàn nǐ zìjǐ xuǎn, huòzhě chī Zhōngguó cài, huòzhě chī Rìběn cài. (Choose dinner yourself: either Chinese or Japanese food.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǎnfàn nǐ zìjǐ xuǎn, huòzhě chī Zhōngguó cài, huòzhě chī Rìběn cài.
grammarPhrases.translation: Choose dinner yourself: either Chinese or Japanese food.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Elige tú mismo la cena: ya sea comida china o japonesa.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 雨已经下起来了。
grammarPhrases.english: Yǔ yǐjīng xià qǐlai le. (The rain has already started falling.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(2) “起来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Yǔ yǐjīng xià qǐlai le.
grammarPhrases.translation: The rain has already started falling.
grammarPhrases.spanish: La lluvia ya ha empezado a caer.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 最近天气热起来了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zuìjìn tiānqì rè qǐlai le. (Lately the weather has started getting hot.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(2) “起来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì rè qǐlai le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Lately the weather has started getting hot.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Últimamente el tiempo ha empezado a hacer calor.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 怎么突然刮起风来了？
grammarPhrases.english: Zěnme tūrán guā qǐ fēng lái le? (How did it suddenly start blowing wind?)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(2) “起来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zěnme tūrán guā qǐ fēng lái le?
grammarPhrases.translation: How did it suddenly start blowing wind?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Cómo empezó de repente a soplar viento?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
grammarPhrases.english: Běijīng chángcháng xiàxuě, dàn tīngshuō jīnnián jiù xià le yí cì. (Beijing often snows, but I heard this year it only snowed once.)
grammarPhrases.source: 范围副词“就” 的用法
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Běijīng chángcháng xiàxuě, dàn tīngshuō jīnnián jiù xià le yí cì.
grammarPhrases.translation: Beijing often snows, but I heard this year it only snowed once.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En Beijing nieva a menudo, pero he oído que este año sólo nevó una vez.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他昨天就看了十分钟书。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā zuótiān jiù kàn le shí fēnzhōng shū. (He only read for 10 minutes yesterday.)
grammarPhrases.source: 范围副词“就” 的用法
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā zuótiān jiù kàn le shí fēnzhōng shū.
grammarPhrases.translation: He only read for 10 minutes yesterday.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Ayer solo leyó 10 minutos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ měitiān shūbāo lǐ dōu fàngzhe yǔsǎn, jiù jīntiān méi dài. (I keep an umbrella in my bag every day, except today I didn't bring it.)
grammarPhrases.source: 范围副词“就” 的用法
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shūbāo lǐ dōu fàngzhe yǔsǎn, jiù jīntiān méi dài.
grammarPhrases.translation: I keep an umbrella in my bag every day, except today I didn't bring it.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Guardo un paraguas en mi bolso todos los días, excepto que hoy no lo traje.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你们点的菜都挺好吃的，就我点的这个菜不太好吃。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐmen diǎn de cài dōu tǐng hǎochī de, jiù wǒ diǎn de zhège cài bú tài hǎochī. (All the dishes you ordered are good, except the one I ordered isn't.)
grammarPhrases.source: 范围副词“就” 的用法
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐmen diǎn de cài dōu tǐng hǎochī de, jiù wǒ diǎn de zhège cài bú tài hǎochī.
grammarPhrases.translation: All the dishes you ordered are good, except the one I ordered isn't.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Todos los platos que pediste son buenos, excepto el que pedí no lo es.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè yì nián duō zhù xiàlai, wǒ háishi gèng xǐhuan Běijīng de sìjì. (After living through this past year and more, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(3) “下来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè yì nián duō zhù xiàlai, wǒ háishi gèng xǐhuan Běijīng de sìjì.
grammarPhrases.translation: After living through this past year and more, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Después de vivir este último año y más, sigo prefiriendo las cuatro estaciones de Beijing.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这半年练下来，他画画的水平提高了不少。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè bàn nián liàn xiàlai, tā huàhuà de shuǐpíng tígāo le bù shǎo. (After practicing through these six months, his painting skill improved greatly.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(3) “下来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè bàn nián liàn xiàlai, tā huàhuà de shuǐpíng tígāo le bù shǎo.
grammarPhrases.translation: After practicing through these six months, his painting skill improved greatly.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Después de practicar durante estos seis meses, su habilidad para pintar mejoró enormemente.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 5000米的长跑比赛，没想到我跑下来了。
grammarPhrases.english: 5000 mǐ de chángpǎo bǐsài, méi xiǎngdào wǒ pǎo xiàlai le. (In the 5,000-meter race, I never expected I would manage to finish running it.)
grammarPhrases.source: 趋向补语的引申用法(3) “下来”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: 5000 mǐ de chángpǎo bǐsài, méi xiǎngdào wǒ pǎo xiàlai le.
grammarPhrases.translation: In the 5,000-meter race, I never expected I would manage to finish running it.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En la carrera de 5.000 metros, nunca esperé que lograría terminar de correrla.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你们有时间的话，就来我家做客。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐmen yǒu shíjiān dehuà, jiù lái wǒ jiā zuòkè. (If you have time, come visit my home.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐmen yǒu shíjiān dehuà, jiù lái wǒ jiā zuòkè.
grammarPhrases.translation: If you have time, come visit my home.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Si tienes tiempo, ven a visitar mi casa.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你觉得满意的话，咱们就买。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ juéde mǎnyì dehuà, zánmen jiù mǎi. (If you are satisfied, let's buy it.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ juéde mǎnyì dehuà, zánmen jiù mǎi.
grammarPhrases.translation: If you are satisfied, let's buy it.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Si estás satisfecho, comprámoslo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 明天天气好的话，我就去爬山。
grammarPhrases.english: Míngtiān tiānqì hǎo dehuà, wǒ jiù qù páshān. (If the weather is nice tomorrow, I'll go hiking.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì hǎo dehuà, wǒ jiù qù páshān.
grammarPhrases.translation: If the weather is nice tomorrow, I'll go hiking.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Si mañana hace buen tiempo, haré senderismo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你把声音开得太大了，我去关小一点儿。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le, wǒ qù guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr. (You turned the sound up too loud; I'll turn it down a bit.)
grammarPhrases.source: “把”字句(4) 趋向或状态变化
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le, wǒ qù guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
grammarPhrases.translation: You turned the sound up too loud; I'll turn it down a bit.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Subiste el sonido demasiado alto; Lo bajaré un poco.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我把饮料和酒都放进冰箱里了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ bǎ yǐnliào hé jiǔ dōu fàng jìn bīngxiāng lǐ le. (I put all the drinks and wine into the fridge.)
grammarPhrases.source: “把”字句(4) 趋向或状态变化
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yǐnliào hé jiǔ dōu fàng jìn bīngxiāng lǐ le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I put all the drinks and wine into the fridge.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Puse todas las bebidas y el vino en el frigorífico.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你把字写得太小了，我看不清楚。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ bǎ zì xiě de tài xiǎo le, wǒ kàn bu qīngchu. (You wrote the characters too small; I can't see them clearly.)
grammarPhrases.source: “把”字句(4) 趋向或状态变化
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ zì xiě de tài xiǎo le, wǒ kàn bu qīngchu.
grammarPhrases.translation: You wrote the characters too small; I can't see them clearly.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Escribiste los caracteres demasiado pequeños; No puedo verlos claramente.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 咱们一边吃蛋糕，一边聊天儿吧。
grammarPhrases.english: Zánmen yìbiān chī dàngāo, yìbiān liáotiānr ba. (Let's chat while eating cake.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zánmen yìbiān chī dàngāo, yìbiān liáotiānr ba.
grammarPhrases.translation: Let's chat while eating cake.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Charlemos mientras comemos pastel.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我喜欢一边跑步，一边听音乐。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ xǐhuan yìbiān pǎobù, yìbiān tīng yīnyuè. (I like listening to music while running.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yìbiān pǎobù, yìbiān tīng yīnyuè.
grammarPhrases.translation: I like listening to music while running.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Me gusta escuchar música mientras corro.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你不应该边开车边打电话。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ bù yīnggāi biān kāichē biān dǎ diànhuà. (You shouldn't talk on the phone while driving.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ bù yīnggāi biān kāichē biān dǎ diànhuà.
grammarPhrases.translation: You shouldn't talk on the phone while driving.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No debes hablar por teléfono mientras conduces.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这本书被别人借走了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè běn shū bèi biérén jiè zǒu le. (This book was borrowed by someone else.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bèi biérén jiè zǒu le.
grammarPhrases.translation: This book was borrowed by someone else.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Este libro fue prestado por otra persona.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 水果可能被弟弟吃了。
grammarPhrases.english: Shuǐguǒ kěnéng bèi dìdi chī le. (The fruit was probably eaten by little brother.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Shuǐguǒ kěnéng bèi dìdi chī le.
grammarPhrases.translation: The fruit was probably eaten by little brother.
grammarPhrases.spanish: La fruta probablemente se la comió el hermano pequeño.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我们俩经常被叫错名字。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒmen liǎ chángcháng bèi jiào cuò míngzi. (The two of us are often called by the wrong names.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ chángcháng bèi jiào cuò míngzi.
grammarPhrases.translation: The two of us are often called by the wrong names.
grammarPhrases.spanish: A nosotros dos a menudo nos llaman por nombres equivocados.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我要先去图书馆借书，然后去游泳。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ yào xiān qù túshūguǎn jiè shū, ránhòu qù yóuyǒng. (I need to first borrow books from the library, then go swimming.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiān qù túshūguǎn jiè shū, ránhòu qù yóuyǒng.
grammarPhrases.translation: I need to first borrow books from the library, then go swimming.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Primero necesito pedir prestados libros de la biblioteca y luego ir a nadar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你先去买门票，再来这里找我。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ xiān qù mǎi ménpiào, zài lái zhèlǐ zhǎo wǒ. (First buy the tickets, then come find me here.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù mǎi ménpiào, zài lái zhèlǐ zhǎo wǒ.
grammarPhrases.translation: First buy the tickets, then come find me here.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Primero compra las entradas, luego ven a buscarme aquí.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你们先回房间休息一会儿，然后再出来吃晚饭。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐmen xiān huí fángjiān xiūxi yíhuìr, ránhòu zài chūlai chī wǎnfàn. (Rest in your room first, then come out for dinner.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐmen xiān huí fángjiān xiūxi yíhuìr, ránhòu zài chūlai chī wǎnfàn.
grammarPhrases.translation: Rest in your room first, then come out for dinner.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Primero descansa en tu habitación y luego sal a cenar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 紧张什么啊，我们都喜欢听你唱歌，你要相信自己。
grammarPhrases.english: Jǐnzhāng shénme a, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan tīng nǐ chànggē, nǐ yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ. (What's there to be nervous about? We love your singing; believe in yourself.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Jǐnzhāng shénme a, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan tīng nǐ chànggē, nǐ yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ.
grammarPhrases.translation: What's there to be nervous about? We love your singing; believe in yourself.
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Por qué estar nervioso? Nos encanta tu canto; creer en ti mismo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 胖什么啊，你看起来不胖也不瘦。
grammarPhrases.english: Pàng shénme a, nǐ kànqilai bú pàng yě bú shòu. (What do you mean fat? You look neither fat nor thin.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Pàng shénme a, nǐ kànqilai bú pàng yě bú shòu.
grammarPhrases.translation: What do you mean fat? You look neither fat nor thin.
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Qué quieres decir con grasa? No pareces ni gorda ni delgada.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 急什么啊，马上就到了。
grammarPhrases.english: Jí shénme a, mǎshàng jiù dào le. (What's the rush? We're arriving in a moment.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Jí shénme a, mǎshàng jiù dào le.
grammarPhrases.translation: What's the rush? We're arriving in a moment.
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Cuál es la prisa? Llegaremos en un momento.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这几年小区根据他们的需要，有了很多变化。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhè jǐ nián xiǎoqū gēnjù tāmen de xūyào, yǒu le hěn duō biànhuà. (In recent years the complex made many changes according to their needs.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián xiǎoqū gēnjù tāmen de xūyào, yǒu le hěn duō biànhuà.
grammarPhrases.translation: In recent years the complex made many changes according to their needs.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En los últimos años el complejo realizó muchos cambios según sus necesidades.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 根据要求，我们必须参加明天的会议。
grammarPhrases.english: Gēnjù yāoqiú, wǒmen bìxū cānjiā míngtiān de huìyì. (According to the requirements, we must attend tomorrow's meeting.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Gēnjù yāoqiú, wǒmen bìxū cānjiā míngtiān de huìyì.
grammarPhrases.translation: According to the requirements, we must attend tomorrow's meeting.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Según los requisitos, debemos asistir a la reunión de mañana.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 老师根据每个学生的兴趣，选择了不一样的书。
grammarPhrases.english: Lǎoshī gēnjù měi ge xuésheng de xìngqù, xuǎnzé le bù yíyàng de shū. (The teacher chose different books according to each student's interest.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Lǎoshī gēnjù měi ge xuésheng de xìngqù, xuǎnzé le bù yíyàng de shū.
grammarPhrases.translation: The teacher chose different books according to each student's interest.
grammarPhrases.spanish: La maestra eligió diferentes libros según el interés de cada alumno.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 那太多了，我得一点儿一点儿给您讲。
grammarPhrases.english: Nà tài duō le, wǒ děi yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr gěi nín jiǎng. (There are so many; I need to tell you bit by bit.)
grammarPhrases.source: 数量重叠“数词+量词+数词+量词”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nà tài duō le, wǒ děi yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr gěi nín jiǎng.
grammarPhrases.translation: There are so many; I need to tell you bit by bit.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Hay tantos; Necesito decírtelo poco a poco.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 学生们的汉语水平一天一天地提高了。
grammarPhrases.english: Xuéshengmen de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng yìtiān yìtiān de tígāo le. (The students' Chinese level improved day by day.)
grammarPhrases.source: 数量重叠“数词+量词+数词+量词”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Xuéshengmen de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng yìtiān yìtiān de tígāo le.
grammarPhrases.translation: The students' Chinese level improved day by day.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El nivel de chino de los estudiantes mejoró día a día.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他们两个两个地走进去了。
grammarPhrases.english: Tāmen liǎng ge liǎng ge de zǒu jìnqu le. (They walked inside two by two.)
grammarPhrases.source: 数量重叠“数词+量词+数词+量词”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge liǎng ge de zǒu jìnqu le.
grammarPhrases.translation: They walked inside two by two.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Entraron de dos en dos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 在我们中国人看来，黄河像妈妈一样，养了我们几千年。
grammarPhrases.english: Zài wǒmen Zhōngguórén kànlái, Huáng Hé xiàng māmā yíyàng, yǎng le wǒmen jǐ qiān nián. (In the eyes of us Chinese, the Yellow River is like a mother that has nurtured us for thousands of years.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zài wǒmen Zhōngguórén kànlái, Huáng Hé xiàng māmā yíyàng, yǎng le wǒmen jǐ qiān nián.
grammarPhrases.translation: In the eyes of us Chinese, the Yellow River is like a mother that has nurtured us for thousands of years.
grammarPhrases.spanish: A los ojos de los chinos, el río Amarillo es como una madre que nos ha nutrido durante miles de años.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 在同事们看来，她工作非常认真。
grammarPhrases.english: Zài tóngshìmen kànlái, tā gōngzuò fēicháng rènzhēn. (In her colleagues' view, she works very conscientiously.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zài tóngshìmen kànlái, tā gōngzuò fēicháng rènzhēn.
grammarPhrases.translation: In her colleagues' view, she works very conscientiously.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Según sus compañeros, trabaja con mucha conciencia.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 在我看来，每天读书是一种很好的习惯。
grammarPhrases.english: Zài wǒ kànlái, měitiān dúshū shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de xíguàn. (In my view, reading every day is a very good habit.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zài wǒ kànlái, měitiān dúshū shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de xíguàn.
grammarPhrases.translation: In my view, reading every day is a very good habit.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En mi opinión, leer todos los días es un muy buen hábito.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 难过的事情不一会儿就忘了。
grammarPhrases.english: Nánguò de shìqing bù yíhuìr jiù wàng le. (Sad matters were forgotten in no time.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nánguò de shìqing bù yíhuìr jiù wàng le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Sad matters were forgotten in no time.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Los asuntos tristes se olvidaron en poco tiempo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 不一会儿，张校长就来了。
grammarPhrases.english: Bù yíhuìr, Zhāng xiàozhǎng jiù lái le. (Before long, Principal Zhang arrived.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Bù yíhuìr, Zhāng xiàozhǎng jiù lái le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Before long, Principal Zhang arrived.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Al poco tiempo llegó el director Zhang.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 两个小时看起来长，但是不一会儿就过去了。
grammarPhrases.english: Liǎng ge xiǎoshí kànqilai cháng, dànshì bù yíhuìr jiù guòqu le. (Two hours looks long, but it passed in a flash.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Liǎng ge xiǎoshí kànqilai cháng, dànshì bù yíhuìr jiù guòqu le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Two hours looks long, but it passed in a flash.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Dos horas parecen largas, pero pasaron en un instante.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 它一会儿在你脚边睡觉，一会儿在你身上爬。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā yíhuìr zài nǐ jiǎobiān shuìjiào, yíhuìr zài nǐ shēnshang pá. (One moment it sleeps by your feet, the next it climbs on you.)
grammarPhrases.source: 并列复句“一会儿……，一会儿……”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā yíhuìr zài nǐ jiǎobiān shuìjiào, yíhuìr zài nǐ shēnshang pá.
grammarPhrases.translation: One moment it sleeps by your feet, the next it climbs on you.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En un momento duerme a tus pies y al siguiente se trepa sobre ti.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他一会儿进来，一会儿出去，忙得很。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā yíhuìr jìnlái, yíhuìr chūqu, máng de hěn. (He is in and out one moment after another, busy as can be.)
grammarPhrases.source: 并列复句“一会儿……，一会儿……”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā yíhuìr jìnlái, yíhuìr chūqu, máng de hěn.
grammarPhrases.translation: He is in and out one moment after another, busy as can be.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Entra y sale un momento tras otro, muy ocupado.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 最近天气变化很快，一会儿冷，一会儿热。
grammarPhrases.english: Zuìjìn tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, yíhuìr lěng, yíhuìr rè. (Lately the weather changes rapidly, cold one moment and hot the next.)
grammarPhrases.source: 并列复句“一会儿……，一会儿……”
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, yíhuìr lěng, yíhuìr rè.
grammarPhrases.translation: Lately the weather changes rapidly, cold one moment and hot the next.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Últimamente el clima cambia rápidamente, frío en un momento y caluroso al siguiente.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 关于这个问题，我得慢慢给你讲。
grammarPhrases.english: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ děi mànmàn gěi nǐ jiǎng. (Regarding this question, I need to explain it to you slowly.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ děi mànmàn gěi nǐ jiǎng.
grammarPhrases.translation: Regarding this question, I need to explain it to you slowly.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Con respecto a esta pregunta, necesito explicártela lentamente.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 关于他的要求，我们还要开会以后再决定。
grammarPhrases.english: Guānyú tā de yāoqiú, wǒmen hái yào kāihuì yǐhòu zài juédìng. (Regarding his request, we will decide after the meeting.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Guānyú tā de yāoqiú, wǒmen hái yào kāihuì yǐhòu zài juédìng.
grammarPhrases.translation: Regarding his request, we will decide after the meeting.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Respecto a su solicitud, decidiremos después de la reunión.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 关于比赛的时间，我明天一定告诉大家。
grammarPhrases.english: Guānyú bǐsài de shíjiān, wǒ míngtiān yídìng gàosu dàjiā. (Regarding the match time, I will definitely tell everyone tomorrow.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Guānyú bǐsài de shíjiān, wǒ míngtiān yídìng gàosu dàjiā.
grammarPhrases.translation: Regarding the match time, I will definitely tell everyone tomorrow.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En cuanto a la hora del partido, definitivamente se lo diré a todos mañana.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 一般来说，熊猫每天要睡很多次觉。
grammarPhrases.english: Yìbānláishuō, xióngmāo měitiān yào shuì hěn duō cì jiào. (Generally speaking, pandas sleep multiple times a day.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, xióngmāo měitiān yào shuì hěn duō cì jiào.
grammarPhrases.translation: Generally speaking, pandas sleep multiple times a day.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En términos generales, los pandas duermen varias veces al día.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 一般来说，这种树每年开一次花。
grammarPhrases.english: Yìbānláishuō, zhè zhǒng shù měinián kāi yí cì huā. (Generally speaking, this tree blooms once a year.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, zhè zhǒng shù měinián kāi yí cì huā.
grammarPhrases.translation: Generally speaking, this tree blooms once a year.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Por lo general, este árbol florece una vez al año.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 一般来说，学习外语需要多练习。
grammarPhrases.english: Yìbānláishuō, xuéxí wàiyǔ xūyào duō liànxí. (Generally speaking, learning a foreign language requires plenty of practice.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, xuéxí wàiyǔ xūyào duō liànxí.
grammarPhrases.translation: Generally speaking, learning a foreign language requires plenty of practice.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En términos generales, aprender un idioma extranjero requiere mucha práctica.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 冬天比夏天早关门一个小时。
grammarPhrases.english: Dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān zǎo guānmén yí ge xiǎoshí. (In winter it closes one hour earlier than in summer.)
grammarPhrases.source: 比较句(11) 数量/时间差
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān zǎo guānmén yí ge xiǎoshí.
grammarPhrases.translation: In winter it closes one hour earlier than in summer.
grammarPhrases.spanish: En invierno cierra una hora antes que en verano.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 哥哥比弟弟多吃了三个饺子。
grammarPhrases.english: Gēge bǐ dìdi duō chī le sān ge jiǎozi. (Older brother ate three more jiaozi than little brother.)
grammarPhrases.source: 比较句(11) 数量/时间差
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Gēge bǐ dìdi duō chī le sān ge jiǎozi.
grammarPhrases.translation: Older brother ate three more jiaozi than little brother.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El hermano mayor comió tres jiaozi más que el hermano pequeño.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我比他晚到了十分钟。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ bǐ tā wǎn dào le shí fēnzhōng. (I arrived ten minutes later than him.)
grammarPhrases.source: 比较句(11) 数量/时间差
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ bǐ tā wǎn dào le shí fēnzhōng.
grammarPhrases.translation: I arrived ten minutes later than him.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Llegué diez minutos más tarde que él.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 别再向前走了，李老师的办公室已经到了。
grammarPhrases.english: Bié zài xiàng qián zǒu le, Lǐ lǎoshī de bàngōngshì yǐjīng dào le. (Don't walk forward anymore; Teacher Li's office is reached.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Bié zài xiàng qián zǒu le, Lǐ lǎoshī de bàngōngshì yǐjīng dào le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Don't walk forward anymore; Teacher Li's office is reached.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No camines más hacia adelante; Se comunica con la oficina del maestro Li.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 以后我要多向认真的人学习。
grammarPhrases.english: Yǐhòu wǒ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí. (From now on I will learn more from conscientious people.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí.
grammarPhrases.translation: From now on I will learn more from conscientious people.
grammarPhrases.spanish: A partir de ahora aprenderé más de gente concienzuda.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 孩子一看见妈妈，就向她跑过去了。
grammarPhrases.english: Háizi yí kànjiàn māmā, jiù xiàng tā pǎo guòqu le. (As soon as the child saw mom, he ran toward her.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Háizi yí kànjiàn māmā, jiù xiàng tā pǎo guòqu le.
grammarPhrases.translation: As soon as the child saw mom, he ran toward her.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Tan pronto como el niño vio a mamá, corrió hacia ella.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你不是喜欢玩电脑吗？你可以去看看跟电脑有关系的书。
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ bú shì xǐhuan wán diànnǎo ma? Nǐ kěyǐ qù kànkan gēn diànnǎo yǒu guānxì de shū. (Don't you like computers? You can check books about computers.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì xǐhuan wán diànnǎo ma? Nǐ kěyǐ qù kànkan gēn diànnǎo yǒu guānxì de shū.
grammarPhrases.translation: Don't you like computers? You can check books about computers.
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿No te gustan las computadoras? Puede consultar libros sobre computadoras.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 你不是说今天有事吗？为什么来了？
grammarPhrases.english: Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yǒu shì ma? Wèishénme lái le? (Didn't you say you were busy today? Why did you come?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yǒu shì ma? Wèishénme lái le?
grammarPhrases.translation: Didn't you say you were busy today? Why did you come?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿No dijiste que estabas ocupado hoy? ¿Por qué viniste?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 考试不是下个月吗？你怎么今天就开始复习了？
grammarPhrases.english: Kǎoshì bú shì xià ge yuè ma? Nǐ zěnme jīntiān jiù kāishǐ fùxí le? (Isn't the exam next month? How come you started reviewing today?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Kǎoshì bú shì xià ge yuè ma? Nǐ zěnme jīntiān jiù kāishǐ fùxí le?
grammarPhrases.translation: Isn't the exam next month? How come you started reviewing today?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿No es el examen el mes que viene? ¿Cómo es que empezaste a revisar hoy?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我还没想好学什么，更没想好去哪个国家。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, gèng méi xiǎnghǎo qù nǎge guójiā. (I haven't decided what to study, let alone which country to go to.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, gèng méi xiǎnghǎo qù nǎge guójiā.
grammarPhrases.translation: I haven't decided what to study, let alone which country to go to.
grammarPhrases.spanish: No he decidido qué estudiar y mucho menos a qué país ir.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 想提高中文水平要多听多看，更要多说多练。
grammarPhrases.english: Xiǎng tígāo Zhōngwén shuǐpíng yào duō tīng duō kàn, gèng yào duō shuō duō liàn. (To improve Chinese you must listen and read a lot, and even more speak and practice.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Xiǎng tígāo Zhōngwén shuǐpíng yào duō tīng duō kàn, gèng yào duō shuō duō liàn.
grammarPhrases.translation: To improve Chinese you must listen and read a lot, and even more speak and practice.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Para mejorar el chino debes escuchar y leer mucho, y aún más hablar y practicar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 来中国学习，我学会了中文，更了解了中国文化。
grammarPhrases.english: Lái Zhōngguó xuéxí, wǒ xuéhuì le Zhōngwén, gèng liǎojiě le Zhōngguó wénhuà. (Studying in China, I learned Chinese and understood Chinese culture even deeper.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó xuéxí, wǒ xuéhuì le Zhōngwén, gèng liǎojiě le Zhōngguó wénhuà.
grammarPhrases.translation: Studying in China, I learned Chinese and understood Chinese culture even deeper.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Al estudiar en China, aprendí chino y entendí la cultura china aún más profundamente.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 只有想清楚自己真正喜欢什么，才能做出最合适的选择。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme, cái néng zuòchū zuì héshì de xuǎnzé. (Only by figuring out what you truly like can you make the most suitable choice.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme, cái néng zuòchū zuì héshì de xuǎnzé.
grammarPhrases.translation: Only by figuring out what you truly like can you make the most suitable choice.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Sólo descubriendo lo que realmente te gusta podrás tomar la decisión más adecuada.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 只有每天锻炼身体，才会越来越健康。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhǐyǒu měitiān duànliàn shēntǐ, cái huì yuèláiyuè jiànkāng. (Only if you exercise daily will you get increasingly healthy.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu měitiān duànliàn shēntǐ, cái huì yuèláiyuè jiànkāng.
grammarPhrases.translation: Only if you exercise daily will you get increasingly healthy.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Sólo si haces ejercicio a diario conseguirás una salud cada vez mayor.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 只有多听、多说、多看，你的中文水平才能提高。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhǐyǒu duō tīng, duō shuō, duō kàn, nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng cái néng tígāo. (Only by listening, speaking, and reading more can your Chinese level improve.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu duō tīng, duō shuō, duō kàn, nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng cái néng tígāo.
grammarPhrases.translation: Only by listening, speaking, and reading more can your Chinese level improve.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Sólo escuchando, hablando y leyendo más podrás mejorar tu nivel de chino.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 春节大概放七八天假。
grammarPhrases.english: Chūnjié dàgài fàng qī-bā tiān jià. (The Spring Festival probably has about 7 or 8 days off.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Chūnjié dàgài fàng qī-bā tiān jià.
grammarPhrases.translation: The Spring Festival probably has about 7 or 8 days off.
grammarPhrases.spanish: El Festival de Primavera probablemente tenga unos 7 u 8 días libres.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 教室里来了五六个学生。
grammarPhrases.english: Jiàoshì lǐ lái le wǔ-liù ge xuésheng. (Five or six students came into the classroom.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ lái le wǔ-liù ge xuésheng.
grammarPhrases.translation: Five or six students came into the classroom.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Cinco o seis estudiantes entraron al aula.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 这些照片是三四年前照的吧？
grammarPhrases.english: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn shì sān-sì nián qián zhào de ba? (Were these photos taken three or four years ago?)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn shì sān-sì nián qián zhào de ba?
grammarPhrases.translation: Were these photos taken three or four years ago?
grammarPhrases.spanish: ¿Estas fotos fueron tomadas hace tres o cuatro años?

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 刚才的电话是我妈妈打来的。
grammarPhrases.english: Gāngcái de diànhuà shì wǒ māmā dǎlai de. (The phone call just now was from my mom.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Gāngcái de diànhuà shì wǒ māmā dǎlai de.
grammarPhrases.translation: The phone call just now was from my mom.
grammarPhrases.spanish: La llamada telefónica de hace un momento fue de mi mamá.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我刚才看过一遍，不想再看了。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ gāngcái kànguo yí biàn, bù xiǎng zài kàn le. (I just looked through it once a moment ago; I don't want to look again.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái kànguo yí biàn, bù xiǎng zài kàn le.
grammarPhrases.translation: I just looked through it once a moment ago; I don't want to look again.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Lo acabo de mirar una vez hace un momento; No quiero volver a mirar.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我刚刚看视频学会了包饺子。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ gānggāng kàn shìpín xuéhuì le bāo jiǎozi. (I just learned how to make dumplings by watching videos.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng kàn shìpín xuéhuì le bāo jiǎozi.
grammarPhrases.translation: I just learned how to make dumplings by watching videos.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Aprendí a hacer bolas de masa viendo videos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他刚刚来北京两个月。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā gānggāng lái Běijīng liǎng ge yuè. (He has only just been in Beijing for two months.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā gānggāng lái Běijīng liǎng ge yuè.
grammarPhrases.translation: He has only just been in Beijing for two months.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Apenas lleva dos meses en Beijing.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 我只要几天不跟他视频，就很想他。
grammarPhrases.english: Wǒ zhǐyào jǐ tiān bù gēn tā shìpín, jiù hěn xiǎng tā. (As long as I don't video chat with him for a few days, I miss him terribly.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐyào jǐ tiān bù gēn tā shìpín, jiù hěn xiǎng tā.
grammarPhrases.translation: As long as I don't video chat with him for a few days, I miss him terribly.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Mientras no charle por video con él durante unos días, lo extraño muchísimo.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 只要你同意，我们就这么决定了。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhǐyào nǐ tóngyì, wǒmen jiù zhème juédìng le. (As long as you agree, we'll decide on this.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ tóngyì, wǒmen jiù zhème juédìng le.
grammarPhrases.translation: As long as you agree, we'll decide on this.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Siempre que esté de acuerdo, decidiremos al respecto.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 只要你坚持每天早睡，身体就一定会好起来。
grammarPhrases.english: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān zǎoshuì, shēntǐ jiù yídìng huì hǎo qǐlai. (As long as you stick to going to bed early daily, your health will surely improve.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān zǎoshuì, shēntǐ jiù yídìng huì hǎo qǐlai.
grammarPhrases.translation: As long as you stick to going to bed early daily, your health will surely improve.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Siempre que te acuestes temprano todos los días, tu salud seguramente mejorará.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 他从那时起就努力学习。
grammarPhrases.english: Tā cóng nà shí qǐ jiù nǔlì xuéxí. (He studied hard from that time onward.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Tā cóng nà shí qǐ jiù nǔlì xuéxí.
grammarPhrases.translation: He studied hard from that time onward.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Estudió mucho a partir de ese momento.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 从那天起，我们就变成了好朋友。
grammarPhrases.english: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒmen jiù biànchéng le hǎo péngyou. (From that day forward, we became good friends.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒmen jiù biànchéng le hǎo péngyou.
grammarPhrases.translation: From that day forward, we became good friends.
grammarPhrases.spanish: A partir de ese día nos hicimos buenos amigos.

grammarPhrases.hanzi: 从那次旅游起，我对中国文化更有兴趣了。
grammarPhrases.english: Cóng nà cì lǚyóu qǐ, wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gèng yǒu xìngqù le. (Ever since that trip, I became even more interested in Chinese culture.)
grammarPhrases.pinyin: Cóng nà cì lǚyóu qǐ, wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gèng yǒu xìngqù le.
grammarPhrases.translation: Ever since that trip, I became even more interested in Chinese culture.
grammarPhrases.spanish: Desde ese viaje, me interesé aún más por la cultura china.
